description:
We are seeking a dynamic IoT Technichal Architect to join our São Paulo team. This role is pivotal in bridging between our technical offerings and customer needs, ensuring seamless integration and deployment of our IoT solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Pre-Sales Support: Collaborate with the sales team to understand customer requirements and design tailored IoT solutions that leverage Acceleronix’s offerings.

Qualifications

  • Communication Skills Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical information clearly to diverse audiences in Portuguese, English, and Spanish.
  • Customer-Centric Demonstrated ability to understand and align solutions with customer business goals.

description:
SUPERVISOR COMERCIAL CARTÕES - ATACADÃO CUIABA

Descrição da Vaga

Prazer, somos a Teleturbo e o Grupo Netway!

Aqui, temos um grande time que faz tudo acontecer! É com o esforço e a dedicação de cada uma das nossas pessoas que nos tornamos referência no que fazemos, atuando unidos em nosso propósito: “Superar expectativas, conectando pessoas e organizações, rompendo fronteiras.”

Com presença em mais de 40 cidades em diversos estados do Brasil, levamos conexão de alta qualidade e estabilidade, somando mais de 70.000 clientes em todo o país.

Nossa conexão vai além de oferecer internet confiável. Contamos com rota própria até São Paulo, o que garante maior desempenho no acesso a sites e jogos hospedados na região.

Também oferecemos Serviços de Valor Agregado (SVA) que se conectam ao nosso público, como: Max, Paramount+, Globoplay, Telemedicina, entre outros.

Nosso compromisso vai além da internet — buscamos proporcionar bem-estar, praticidade e evolução tecnológica para nossos clientes.

Venha para o Grupo Netway e deixe sua marca fazendo história!

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

Missão: Liderar a operação comercial no segmento condominial, abrindo novas portas, organizando o time e garantindo a excelência nas metas e no relacionamento com as lideranças de cada condomínio.

  • SUPERVISIONAR EQUIPES: Supervisiona equipes de promotores e consultores B2C em campo (porta a porta e pontos físicos).
  • ACOMPANHAMENTO DE CAMPANHAS: Acompanha a execução de ações promocionais e campanhas locais.
  • CONTROLE DE FUNIL DE VENDAS: Apoia o controle do funil de vendas e registros no CRM.
  • DIRECIONAMENTO DE LEADS: Garante o correto direcionamento de leads gerados via digital ou físico.
  • RELATÓRIOS DE VENDAS: Auxilia na elaboração de relatórios simples de vendas e conversões.
  • BRIEFINGS DIÁRIOS: Conduz briefings diários e incentiva a equipe na busca por metas.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Noções de estratégias de vendas B2C (campo e loja).
  • Conhecimento prático em abordagem ao cliente final.
  • Capacidade de operar e acompanhar cadastros e propostas no CRM.
  • Conhecimento básico em controle de metas e relatórios.
  • Curso superior completo ou incompleto. “Administraçao”.

Para fazer parte do nosso time, é essencial:

  • Ser proativo(a): agir com autonomia e antecipar soluções;
  • Atenção aos detalhes: entregar tarefas com qualidade e precisão;
  • Foco no cliente: priorizar a excelência no atendimento;
  • Vontade de aprender: demonstrar interesse em crescer e evoluir;
  • Colaboração: ter espírito de equipe e atitude positiva;
  • Respeito e cordialidade: manter postura ética com todos.

A nossa cultura é o nosso DNA! Ela sustentou nosso sucesso até aqui e continuará sendo a base para o futuro. Para proporcionar uma jornada completa e positiva, oferecemos.

title: Machine Learning Engineer Sênior/Especialista
description:
Join to apply for the Machine Learning Engineer Sênior/Especialista role at Ideen

Estamos em busca de um(a) Machine Learning Engineer para atuar em um cliente do setor financeiro que está acelerando sua jornada em dados e inteligência artificial. Você será responsável por desenhar, treinar, avaliar e colocar em produção modelos de Machine Learning e Deep Learning, trabalhando com grandes volumes de dados, problemas complexos de negócio (risco, crédito, fraude, comportamento, operações) e, cada vez mais, com LLMs e técnicas modernas como RAG e modelos foundation. Esperamos alguém com rigor técnico, visão analítica e capacidade de transformar dados em decisões concretas, conectando pesquisa aplicada, engenharia de software e impacto real no negócio.

O que esperamos de você

  • Experiência sólida com Python, bibliotecas de ciência de dados e ML (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow ou similares).
  • Vivência com modelagem estatística, ML supervisionado e não supervisionado, DL e avaliação de modelos.
  • Conhecimento de bancos de dados e SQL, incluindo otimização de consultas e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Experiência em tratamento e análise de dados complexos (datasets grandes, ruidosos ou de alta dimensionalidade).
  • Noções de LLMs e GenAI (uso de APIs, fine‑tuning, RAG, embeddings, avaliação de saídas).
  • Capacidade de formular hipóteses, desenhar experimentos e interpretar resultados com pensamento crítico.
  • Familiaridade com ambientes em cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure) aplicados a dados e ML.
  • Inglês avançado para leitura, escrita técnica e eventual interação com stakeholders globais.

Tarefas

  • Desenvolver e evoluir modelos de Machine Learning e Deep Learning para casos de uso como: previsão e modelagem de risco, churn, fraude, inadimplência; segmentação e clustering de clientes e comportamentos; classificação, ranking e recomendação.
  • Trabalhar com LLMs e GenAI em cenários que exijam RAG, sumarização, classificação de texto, análise de documentos e assistentes internos.
  • Estruturar pipelines de dados e de treinamento, desde preparação e feature engineering até deployment em produção.
  • Implementar rotinas de avaliação, monitoramento e re‑treino de modelos (drift, performance, acurácia, fairness).
  • Colaborar com times de dados, produto, engenharia e negócio para entender problemas, formatar hipóteses e validar soluções.
  • Documentar metodologias, experimentos, resultados e decisões de modelagem de forma clara e auditável.
  • Atuar na melhoria contínua de qualidade de dados: consistência, limpeza, enriquecimento e governança.
  • Apoiar a definição e implementação de boas práticas de MLOps em parceria com engenharia e plataforma.

Formação

Superior Completo: Formação em instituições de referência (USP, Unicamp, ITA, UFRJ, CBPF, INPE, IME, Poli, UFMG, Insper, etc.) - não é impeditivo ter a graduação em outras instituições.

Title: Resource Manager, Professional Services
Business Unit: Graphic Communications
Department: Customer & Professional Services
Location: Brazil, Remote
About Us
Graphic Communications, a CAI Division, is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for the print industy. Graphic Communications' integrated and automated offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With over thirty years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the packaging and printing industries, it is the company's deeply held philosophy that they succeed when its customers thrive.
Position Overview
The Resource Manager plays a critical role in ensuring Professional Services teams are properly staffed, aligned, and equipped to meet project timelines and business objectives. This role involves close collaboration with Project Managers, Project Coordinators, Regional Managers, the Sr. Director of Professional Services, Customer Success, and Sales to efficiently manage resources, balance workloads, and ensure smooth project delivery.
Core Responsibilities
Resource Planning and Allocation
Identify, assign, and allocate resources to ongoing and upcoming projects based on skills, availability, and priorities.
Maintain a real-time view of resource capacity and project needs across the organization.
Serve as the primary point of contact for project staffing and collaborate with Sales and Regional Managers to ensure proper coverage for upcoming engagements.
Own all new engagements at intake and assign resources based on availability and skillset.
Check in regularly with Project Managers to confirm they have the resources required for project success.
Maintain up-to-date skills and certifications records for all consultants.Forecasting and Talent Management
Collaborate with Sales, Project Managers, Regional Managers, and leadership to forecast future resource requirements.
Identify resource gaps and recommend cross-training, recruitment, or subcontracting needs based on upcoming opportunities.
Support long-term workforce planning and professional development of consultants.
Process Optimization and Tool Management
Develop and maintain tools, dashboards, and reports to monitor utilization, productivity, and performance.
Establish and enforce consistent processes for resource requests and assignments to maximize efficiency.
Ensure data and processes remain aligned across systems.
Daily Operational Responsibilities
New Engagement Intake
Review new projects pushed from Salesforce into Wrike.
Confirm all project metadata: customer, region, product, estimated hours, and key contacts.
Confirm the correct Wrike template and folder structure were created.
If automation fails, manually create projects using Salesforce data.
Assignment & Scheduling
Review unassigned Wrike projects daily.
Match consultants to projects based on skill set, availability, and regional needs.
Assign both primary and secondary consultants and confirm schedules with stakeholders.
Flag any assignment conflicts or delays to Regional Managers or Services Leads.
System Sync and Integration Oversight
Cross-reference Salesforce ? Wrike and Wrike ? NetSuite mappings to ensure accuracy.
Validate billing fields (sold-to ID, billing trigger, engagement type) and confirm correct syncing.
Ensure Concur sync processes are updating users, vendors, and expenses accurately.
Monitor Wrike integration logs and escalate issues as needed.
Maintain field mapping and oversee sync processes across Salesforce, NetSuite, and Concur.
Track and resolve open integration issues in collaboration with Operations.
Time Tracking Oversight
Validate daily timesheet entries for all consultants.
Identify missing, misallocated, or excessive time entries and follow up as needed.
Escalate persistent noncompliance to Regional Managers.
Ensure adherence to time entry policies for accurate utilization and billing reporting.
Project Health & Status Monitoring
Monitor project dashboards in Wrike for task completion, budget consumption, and forecasted effort.
Reporting & Communication
Participate in regular syncs with Regional Managers.
Track upcoming projects, resourcing constraints, and urgent escalations.
Respond to inquiries regarding capacity, project swaps, or timeline adjustments.
Provide data for utilization, staffing, revenue forecasting, and any other Professional Services metrics.
Performance and Collaboration
Monitor workload balance across consultants.
Participate in resource reviews with Regional Managers to support continuous development based on Sales forecast.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Services teams to align timelines, priorities, and dependencies.
Qualifications
Experience:
4+ years of experience in resource planning or operations within a software or technology organization.
Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and balance resources effectively in a fast-paced environment.
Skills
Strong proficiency with resource planning tools (e.g., Wrike)
Working Knowledge Of JIRA, Salesforce, Required, And NetSuite Preferred.
Excellent organizational, communication, and negotiation skills.

description:

You’re not the person who will settle for just any role. Neither are we. Here, you’ll bring your professional expertise, talent, and drive to building and managing our portfolio of iconic, ground‑breaking brands. In this role, you’ll help us deliver better care for billions of people around the world. It starts with YOU.

We are seeking a highly skilled and visionary Visualization Architect to lead the design, development, and optimization of enterprise‑grade dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI. This role requires deep expertise in DAX coding, data modeling, and visualization best practices to transform complex data into actionable insights for business stakeholders.

The ideal candidate is a people leader deeply invested in fostering robust relationships with stakeholders and empowering our team. This person thrives on collaboration and guiding teams with a hands‑on, empathetic approach, ensuring alignment with our strategic objectives. With a passion for data‑driven solutions, this leader will oversee the integration of Snowflake and advanced reporting and self‑service technologies, enhancing our capabilities to connect with and serve our clients effectively.

In this role, you will:

  • Architect and implement scalable Business Intelligence Visualization solutions that meet business requirements and performance standards.
  • Design and develop advanced DAX measures and calculated columns to support complex analytical needs.
  • Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, and business users to understand data sources and reporting requirements.
  • Establish and enforce visualization standards, governance, and best practices across the organization.
  • Optimize Power BI datasets and reports for performance, usability, and scalability.
  • Lead the migration of legacy reports to Power BI, ensuring data integrity and improved user experience.
  • Mentor and guide junior developers and analysts on Power BI and DAX techniques.
  • Stay current with Power BI updates, features, and industry trends to continuously improve reporting capabilities.

About Us

Huggies®. Kleenex®. Cottonelle®. Scott®. Kotex®. Poise®. Depend®. Kimberly‑Clark Professional®. You already know our legendary brands—and so does the rest of the world. In fact, millions of people use Kimberly‑Clark products every day. We know these amazing Kimberly‑Clark products wouldn’t exist without talented professionals, like you.

At Kimberly‑Clark, you’ll be part of the best team committed to driving innovation, growth and impact. We’re founded on more than 150 years of market leadership, and we’re always looking for new and better ways to perform – so there’s your open door of opportunity. It’s all here for you at Kimberly‑Clark.

About You

You perform at the highest level possible, and you appreciate a performance culture fueled by authentic caring. You want to be part of a company actively dedicated to sustainability, inclusion, wellbeing, and career development.

You love what you do, especially when the work you do makes a difference. At Kimberly‑Clark, we’re constantly exploring new ideas on how, when, and where we can best achieve results. When you join our team, you’ll experience Flex

That Works: flexible work arrangements that empower you to have purposeful time in the office and partner with your leader to make flexibility work for both you and the business.

In one of our professional roles, you’ll focus on winning with consumers and the market, while putting safety, mutual respect, and human dignity at the center. To succeed in this role, you will need the following qualifications:

Experience & Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in Business Intelligence Visualization development, including dashboard creation and data modeling.
  • Expert‑level proficiency in DAX and Power Query (M language).
  • Strong understanding of data warehousing, ETL processes, and dimensional modeling.
  • Experience with Power BI Service, including workspace management, dataflows, and deployment pipelines.
  • Familiarity with Row‑Level Security (RLS) and governance practices.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Experience in Commercial and Supply Chain domains.
  • Experience with Azure Data Services (e.g., Azure Synapse, Data Factory, SQL Database).
  • Strong experience with Snowflake, including writing efficient SQL queries and managing data pipelines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of Python or R for advanced analytics.
  • Microsoft Power BI certification (e.g., DA‑100 or PL‑300).
  • Experience with Business Intelligence in the Consumer‑Packaged Goods (CPG) industry.

As part of the Core Engineering team, you'll play a key role in building the scalable, reliable systems that power our travel platform—from supplier integrations and search to pricing and booking. You'll craft and deliver backend solutions that drive our mission to simplify business travel and elevate the traveler experience.

You'll collaborate closely with cross-functional teams across product and data, solving complex technical challenges that directly impact Engine's growth and customer satisfaction. title: Especialista de Infraestrutura
description:
Job description

A Minerva Foods é líder em exportação de carne bovina na América do Sul e atua também no segmento de industrializados, comercializando seus produtos para mais de 100 países. Além do Brasil, a Minerva Foods está presente no Paraguai, na Argentina, no Uruguai, na Colômbia, e possui plantas especializadas em ovinos na Austrália.

Com nossas 46 unidades industriais, oferecemos produtos saudáveis e nutritivos, que são comercializados para clientes do mundo todo por meio de nossos 23 centros de distribuição e 17 escritórios internacionais.

Cultura Organizacional

Na Minerva Foods, a cultura é construída com base em valores como orientação para resultados, comprometimento, inovação, sustentabilidade e reconhecimento . A empresa promove um ambiente inclusivo, seguro e saudável, com programas como o Estar Bem, que oferece apoio psicológico, telemedicina, nutrição e atividades físicas para colaboradores e suas famílias.

Como Especialista de Infraestrutura na Minerva Foods, você será responsável pela operação e manutenção de ambientes críticos de tecnologia, garantindo a estabilidade, disponibilidade e performance dos serviços corporativos. Atuará diretamente na sustentação de servidores, redes, serviços em nuvem e suporte de nível avançado, colaborando com equipes internas e fornecedores para assegurar a continuidade dos negócios. Além disso, será parte ativa na identificação de oportunidades de melhoria contínua, contribuindo para a evolução dos processos, aumento da eficiência operacional e redução de riscos técnicos.

Main responsibilities

O Especialista de Infraestrutura será um pilar técnico na equipe, responsável por garantir que nossos sistemas e redes operem com máxima eficiência, segurança e escalabilidade.

Principais atividades:

  • Gerenciamento de Infraestrutura: Administrar, sustentar e otimizar a infraestrutura de servidores (físicos e virtuais), storages e soluções de backup;
  • Administração de Redes: Gerenciar e proteger o ambiente de rede corporativa (LAN, WAN, WLAN, VPNs), incluindo a configuração e manutenção de firewalls e outros dispositivos de segurança;
  • Serviços de Diretório e Nuvem: Administrar o Active Directory, incluindo GPOs, DNS, DHCP, e gerenciar os serviços em nuvem, com foco no ecossistema Microsoft 365 (Azure AD, SharePoint, Teams);
  • Segurança da Informação: Implementar e gerenciar soluções de segurança, realizar análises de vulnerabilidade e garantir a correta aplicação das políticas de autenticação (ex: RADIUS/NPS);
  • Liderança de Projetos: Planejar, executar e documentar projetos de infraestrutura, como migrações de sistemas operacionais (ex: Windows 11), atualizações de hardware e implementação de novas tecnologias;
  • Melhoria Contínua: Analisar o ambiente atual, propor melhorias contínuas nos processos e tecnologias para aumentar a eficiência operacional, reduzir custos e mitigar riscos;
  • Suporte Especializado: Atuar como ponto de escalonamento para incidentes e problemas complexos, oferecendo soluções robustas e definitivas.

Experiências que buscamos:

  • Sólida experiência atuando como Analista de Infraestrutura Sênior ou Especialista;
  • Vivência comprovada em ambientes de virtualização;
  • Experiência prática com gerenciamento de redes corporativas e firewalls de borda;
  • Profundo conhecimento em administração de ambientes Microsoft, incluindo Windows Server e Active Directory;
  • Experiência com administração de plataformas em nuvem, preferencialmente AWS, Microsoft Azure e Microsoft 365;
  • Familiaridade com práticas de melhoria contínua.

Requirements and skills

Formação: Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

Conhecimentos Técnicos Essenciais:

  • Sistemas Operacionais: Windows Server (avançado), Linux (diferencial);
  • Virtualização: VMware vSphere e/ou Microsoft Hyper‑V;
  • Cloud Computing: AWS, Microsoft Azure (IaaS, PaaS) e Microsoft 365;
  • Redes: TCP/IP, roteamento, switching, WiFi, VPNs, Firewalls;
  • Autenticação: RADIUS, NPS, LDAP, SAML;
  • Automação: Conhecimentos em scripting, especialmente PowerShell, para automação de tarefas no Active Directory e Azure.

Cursos e Certificações (Diferencial):

  • Certificações Microsoft (ex: Azure Administrator Associate, MCSA/MCSE);
  • Certificações de Redes (ex: Fortinet NSE 4, Cisco CCNA);
  • Certificação ITIL Foundation.

Additional information

Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto (home office), com necessidade de deslocamento para nossa sede em Barretos/SP em média 4 vezes ao ano para alinhamentos e eventos de equipe.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista de Tecnologia da Informação – SRE (Site Reliability Engineer) , com foco em confiabilidade, automação e observabilidade de sistemas. Essa posição é estratégica para impulsionar a transformação do negócio, promovendo a modernização tecnológica e a adoção de soluções digitais mais atuais.

Se você tem perfil analítico, é colaborativo(a), gosta de resolver problemas com agilidade e possui iniciativa para colocar a mão na massa, essa vaga é para você!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Integração de soluções de observabilidade em pipelines de CI/CD AzureDevops;
  • Configuração e gerenciamento de ferramentas de monitoramento (Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog);
  • Administração de Aplicações WEB, Middlewares, APIs, microservices;
  • Gestão em Devops, AzureDevops deploy Kubernet;
  • Suportar aplicações, serviços, eventos e performance de servidores Linux/Unix;
  • Implementação de práticas de MELT (Métricas, Logs e Tracing) para análise e resolução de problemas;
  • Criação e gestão de alertas e notificações com base em métricas e logs;
  • Monitoramento do desempenho dos sistemas e identificação de gargalos;
  • Apoio na resposta a incidentes, com análise de causa raiz e pós-mortem;
  • Colaboração com equipes de infraestrutura e DevOps no uso de ferramentas de automação, como Python, Ansible, Terraform e Kubernetes.

Requisitos e qualificações

Experiências desejadas:

  • Experiência com monitoramento e observabilidade de sistemas distribuídos e microservices, Aplicações WEB, Middlewares, APIs, microservices e containers: Nginx, Apache, IIS, Tomcat, JBoss, PM2, Gravitee, Docker;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de APM (ex: Dynatrace, AppDynamics);
  • Familiaridade com cloud computing (GCP) e Infraestrutura como Código (IaC);
  • Conhecimento em segurança de TI e melhores práticas de proteção de dados;
  • Habilidades em programação (Python, Bash) e integração de APIs;
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis e práticas de DevOps;
  • Conhecimento em integrações com banco de dados.

Diferenciais

  • Certificações relevantes (ex: AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer);
  • Vivência com outras plataformas de cloud computing (AWS, Azure);
  • Conhecimento em contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de automação e configuração (Chef, Puppet).

Habilidades e comportamentos que fazem a diferença

  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa em um ambiente dinâmico e multifuncional;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação para resolução de problemas;
  • Atitude proativa, com foco em execução, iniciativa e agilidade na entrega de resultados.

Informações adicionais

Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto

Local de Trabalho: São Paulo/SP

  • Vale-refeição ou Vale-alimentação;
  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Day off no dia do aniversário;
  • Wellhub;

Na Quali valorizamos e respeitamos a diversidade em todas as suas formas, e consideramos isso como essencial para construirmos ambientes mais saudáveis e criativos. Por isso, as candidaturas de todas, todos e todes são consideradas e avaliadas para qualquer posição.

title: Partner Sales Director - IHV Alliances
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Partner Sales Director - IHV Alliances role at Canonical .

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced IHV Alliance Sales Director to join our strategic partnerships team who will be responsible for leading IHV Alliances in the EMEA or APAC regions. Reporting to the Head of IHV Alliances, the IHV Alliance Sales Director will work closely with IHV and Canonical teams in those geographies to develop and maintain strong relationships with senior executives at strategic partner organizations, fostering collaboration and alignment on joint business objectives. The IHV Alliance Sales Director will manage and grow a team of Business Development Managers and help them identify and pursue new business opportunities with IHVs, driving revenue growth and market expansion, develop and execute go-to-market strategies for joint offerings, oversee the day-to-day management of alliances including contract negotiations and performance tracking, and issue resolution. The Director is responsible for building trusted relationships with IHV partners, increasing Canonical market share and attach rate, evangelising the partnership and leading all business interactions from engineer to CxO. They will often run customer workshops focused on particular initiatives at that customer, attend sales events, give public presentations and lead executive engagements. Location: This role will be based remotely in EMEA or APAC regions.

As an IHV Alliance Sales Director you will:

  • Build strategic relationships with IHV partners at all levels
  • Grow their awareness of open source capabilities on Canonical Ubuntu
  • Demonstrate a deep understanding of the Linux and cloud software ecosystem
  • Negotiate contracts and commercial business terms
  • Demonstrate a deep understanding of large and complex organizations
  • Lead partnerships in APAC with companies like Lenovo, Huawei, Quanta, Fujitsu, Inspur, H3C, NEC, Asus etc.
  • Lead partnerships in EMEA with companies like Ericsson, Nokia, Bull, Siemens
  • Lead partnerships in the Americas with companies like Dell, HPE, IBM, Supermicro
  • Work closely with marketing, sales engineering and product management
  • Deliver on targets, objectives and provide a voice of the partner
  • Lead executive interlocks between IHV and Canonical leadership
  • Travel regularly - sometimes internationally - to drive partnerships in person

Valued skills and experience

  • Experience in alliance or indirect sales management roles
  • Autonomous, disciplined, hands-on, get-it-done mentality
  • Ability to capture customer requirements, evaluate gaps, identify and create opportunities
  • Passionate about Ubuntu products and mission
  • Comfortable in fast-paced and high pressure environments with measurable goals
  • Experience with Linux, virtualization, containers, and other cloud technologies.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

  • Director

Job function

title: COORDENADOR TI - LIDER TECNICO
description:
Vaga de COORDENADOR TI - LIDER TECNICO em Paraná. R$ 5.000,00 a R$ 7.500,00 (Bruto mensal). Período Integral. Efetivo – CLT Área e especialização profissional: Informática, TI, Telecomunicações - Programador / Desenvolvedor Nível hierárquico: Coordenador Local de trabalho: Curitiba, PR Regime de contratação de tipo Efetivo – CLT Jornada Período Integral Vaga: Líder Técnico / Desenvolvedor Sênior Full-Stack

Descrição da Vaga

Como Líder Técnico / Desenvolvedor Sênior, Você Será Responsável Por Guiar a Equipe Técnica No Desenvolvimento De Aplicações Web Robustas e Distribuídas. Suas Principais Atribuições Incluem:

  • Liderar o design e a implementação de arquiteturas de sistemas distribuídos, garantindo escalabilidade, performance e segurança.
  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações usando tecnologias como C#, JavaScript e React, integrando com bancos de dados PostgreSQL e plataformas como Supabase.
  • Implementar e supervisionar testes automatizados para assegurar a qualidade do código.
  • Aplicar metodologias ágeis, como Scrum, para gerenciar ciclos de desenvolvimento, priorizar tarefas e fomentar a colaboração na equipe.
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores juniores, realizar code reviews e promover melhores práticas de engenharia de software.
  • Colaborar com stakeholders para definir requisitos técnicos e resolver problemas complexos em ambientes de produção.
  • Participar de decisões estratégicas sobre tecnologias e processos, contribuindo para a evolução contínua da nossa stack.

Requisitos Necessários

  • Experiência comprovada de pelo menos 5 anos como Desenvolvedor Full-Stack, com foco em web development.
  • Profundo conhecimento em C# (incluindo .NET Framework/Core) para backend.
  • Domínio de JavaScript (ES6+) e frameworks frontend como React para construção de interfaces modernas e responsivas.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais, especificamente PostgreSQL, e plataformas como Supabase para gerenciamento de dados e autenticação.
  • Conhecimento sólido em arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos, incluindo microservices, APIs RESTful/GraphQL e escalabilidade em nuvem (ex: AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Prática em testes automatizados (unitários, integração e E2E) usando ferramentas como Jest, Mocha, xUnit ou similares.
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis, incluindo Scrum (certificação Scrum Master ou equivalente é um plus).
  • Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou área relacionada.
  • Habilidades de liderança técnica, com capacidade de mentoria e resolução de conflitos em equipe.
  • Fluência em português (escrito e falado); inglês intermediário para leitura de documentações técnicas.

Requisitos Desejáveis

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

Tether and its affiliated entities (e.g. Bitfinex) are searching for an organized self‑starter to join our Regulatory and Licensing team. The successful candidate is someone with a deep understanding of legal and regulatory requirements pertaining to the crypto-asset industry in Brazil, and who is excited by the opportunity to apply their existing regulatory experience in an exciting and dynamic business environment.

The successful candidate will report directly to the Head of Regulatory Affairs & Licensing – Latin America, serving as the primary point of contact for regulatory and licensing matters within Brazil. This is a senior position designed for professionals with proven experience engaging with or working within financial regulators, supervisory authorities, or policy‑making bodies. The ideal candidate combines strategic insight with hands‑on execution, demonstrates a diplomatic, solutions‑oriented approach in navigating complex regulatory environments, and is able to anticipate regulatory changes and adapt strategies proactively to evolving market and legal environments. You will represent the company in regulatory discussions, contribute to regional initiatives under the guidance of the Head of Regulatory Affairs & Licensing – Latin America, and ensure local implementation aligns with the company’s broader Latin American regulatory objectives.

To succeed in this role, the incumbent will continuously strive to self‑develop and enhance their skill sets including understanding the Company’s products and services, blockchain technology, crypto‑assets and the regulatory requirements. Engage with industry associations, chambers, and other stakeholder groups to promote innovation and collaboration.

You will have a focus around translating regulatory requirements in Brazil into clear and actionable strategic recommendations, managing relationships and communications between various stakeholders both internal and external to the business.

Responsibilities

  • Regulatory Strategy Development: development and execution of regulatory strategies, identifying preferable market/s in the region from which to operate. Ensure local implementation aligns with Tether’s broader Latin American regulatory objectives.

  • Regulatory Advocacy and Collaboration: participating in regulatory agency interactions, engaging with relevant regulatory authorities, industry bodies, and policymakers to shape the regulatory landscape for stablecoin issuers, advocating for policies that promote innovation while ensuring safety and compliance. Actively contribute to public consultations, working groups, and industry forums, maintaining a high standard of professionalism and institutional diplomacy.

  • Policy Analysis and Guidance: Provide analysis on local regulatory proposals, and advise the business on potential regulatory risks and opportunities, while driving initiatives to influence regulatory frameworks as well as monitoring for change across regulations to ensure proactive compliance. Produce concise internal policy briefs and recommendations to inform senior management decision‑making.

  • Regulatory approval process: contribute to the process of obtaining necessary license approvals in identified markets, where appropriate. Support the preparation and coordination of documentation and responses to regulatory inquiries, ensuring strategic consistency and accuracy.

  • Cross‑functional Leadership: Collaborate with internal teams (e.g., expansion, legal, compliance, finance) to ensure alignment with regulatory requirements and to proactively address emerging regulatory challenges. Serve as the local regulatory lead, ensuring effective communication and alignment with regional priorities.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 5 years regulatory experience within the financial services or crypto‑asset industry.

  • Preferred: Minimum of 5–8 years regulatory experience within financial services, fintech, or crypto‑asset industries.

  • Ability to apply knowledge of key regulatory frameworks in Brazil both strategically and operationally and provide direction to resolve complex regulatory issues.

  • Demonstrated diplomatic skills and ability to manage complex stakeholder relationships.

  • Expertise in preparing regulatory analysis including the preparation and execution of interactions with regulatory authorities, such as regulatory consultation response submissions.

  • Proven experience working with or within regulatory authorities (e.g., central banks, financial supervisory agencies, or ministries of finance) is strongly preferred.

  • Demonstrated ability to draft or contribute to public policy responses, regulatory filings, or industry position papers.

  • Communication: Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with experience in public speaking and representing companies in regulatory discussions.

  • Must be a strong team player, and willing to be fully engaged with key stakeholders both in our company but also with our partners. Must have hands‑on professional capable of working collaboratively and independently, with excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • Fluency in English and native proficiency in the local language of Brazil.

  • University degree.

  • Advanced degree in Law, Economics, Political Science, or a related field preferred.

Important Information for Candidates

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third‑party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:
  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
  • Double‑check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io.
  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Sobre nós:

St Pauls foi fundada em 1926 e foi a primeira escola na América do Sul a receber um selo oficial do governo do Reino Unido como uma "escola britânica internacional". Com cerca de 1000 alunos com idades entre 3 a 18 anos, é uma escola com tradição e história, mas que também abraça inovação e valores contemporâneos bem como as últimas tendências tecnológicas. Somos membros internacionais da HMC e IAPS e também do COBIS e LAHC. Temos orgulho de nossa reputação local, nacional e internacional e estamos constantemente nos esforçando para melhorar as oportunidades para nossos alunos e colaboradores. Nossa inspeção recente de BSO (British Standards Organization) nos avaliou como uma escola modelo britânica internacional. É possível fazer o download da avaliação em nosso site. Nossa estrutura excepcional coloca o ensino e aprendizagem como parte essencial da escola.

Assista a um vídeo sobre a escola:

Mais detalhes sobre a escola podem ser encontrados em:

Sobre a Função:

O HR Coordinator será responsável por garantir a integridade das informações de pessoas, desenvolver soluções e melhorias de processos, apoiar decisões estratégicas e assegurar conformidade legal. A pessoa atuará de forma muito próxima à gestão, a fornecedores e a outras áreas internas, com grande foco em análise, planeamento, revisão de políticas e supervisão de rotinas críticas de RH.

Principais Responsabilidades:

Gestão de dados e sistemas

  • Revisar e optimizar o HRIS para assegurar dados confiáveis e análises acessíveis.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com TI para desenvolver e aprimorar plataformas de RH.
  • Compilar, cruzar e analisar dados de múltiplas fontes, gerando relatórios recorrentes e insights.

Remuneração, benefícios e orçamento

  • Fazer e acompanhar o orçamento de pessoal e de RH, preparar relatórios e participar de análises sobre custos, headcount e mudanças organizacionais.
  • Revisar tabelas salariais, política de remuneração, validar promoções e méritos, acompanhar pesquisas de mercado e garantir a aplicação das métricas internas.
  • Avaliar a oferta de benefícios, propor melhorias, acompanhar e/ou efetivar negociações com fornecedores e apoiar ajustes contratuais.

Folha de pagamento e conformidade

  • Apoiar o processamento e validar a conferência da folha, horas extras, férias, admissões, demissões e demais rotinas de pessoal.
  • Validar obrigações acessórias e responder a auditorias, contabilidade, consultorias e questionários oficiais.
  • Acompanhar e orientar o trabalho do analista de folha, orientar no processamento de ponto eletrônico e assegurar o cumprimento da legislação trabalhista.

Indicadores e análises

  • Estruturar, atualizar e monitorar KPIs essenciais de RH, como headcount, absenteísmo, horas extras, rotatividade e participação em formação.
  • Criar ferramentas de controle claras, confiáveis e de fácil atualização.

Saúde e segurança

  • Acompanhar relatórios obrigatórios (PGR, PCMSO, AET, LTCAT) e a execução de exames ocupacionais.
  • Gerir casos de afastamento, acidentes e doenças ocupacionais, atuando preventivamente e apoiando a CIPA.
  • Estabelecer interlocução com o médico do trabalho e com fornecedores relevantes.

Suporte geral à área de RH

  • Atender o público interno com clareza e precisão, atualizar os materiais de RH na intranet.
  • Contribuir com projetos de melhoria, revisões de processos e iniciativas estratégicas da área.
  • Trabalhar com flexibilidade operacional para acompanhar prazos e sazonalidades da escola.

Requisitos

  • Mínimo de 2 anos de experiência em folha de pagamento, remuneração e benefícios.
  • Experiência em gestão de dados e KPIs.
  • Excel avançado.
  • Inglês intermédio.
  • Formação em Administração, Recursos Humanos, Contabilidade, Economia, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas correlatas.
  • Atenção aos detalhes, perfil analítico e capacidade de trabalhar com informações sensíveis e complexas.

Perfil Comportamental Esperado

  • Alto grau de responsabilidade, ética e discrição no trato com informações sensíveis;
  • Organização, precisão e foco em qualidade na entrega;
  • Capacidade de gerir múltiplas demandas e prazos com eficiência;
  • Proatividade na busca por melhorias e soluções;
  • Facilidade em trabalhar em equipe, com boa comunicação interpessoal;
  • Resiliência, flexibilidade e disposição para atuar em um ambiente dinâmico e em constante evolução.

title: Supervisor Comercial *(CLT - Presencial em BH)*
description:
Supervisor(a) Comercial**

Esta contratação é para uma empresa cliente. Trata-se de uma grande clínica médica. A atuação é presencial, na unidade de Belo Horizonte.

Segunda a Sexta em horário comercial

Sábado 8h às 12h

*Descrição da vaga:*
Estamos em busca de um(a) Supervisor(a) Comercial para liderar e desenvolver nossos times de pré-vendas e vendas. Essa posição é estratégica para garantir o alinhamento dos processos comerciais, o atingimento de metas e a conexão eficaz entre os times de Marketing e Vendas.

*Responsabilidades:*

* Coordenar e gerenciar os times de SDRs (pré-vendas) e Closers (vendas);
* Acompanhar o desempenho individual e coletivo, garantindo aderência aos processos comerciais;
* Realizar feedbacks estruturados e sessões de role play frequentes para desenvolvimento da equipe;
* Identificar e corrigir inconformidades no processo comercial;
* Gerar relatórios gerenciais e de performance para a diretoria;
* Gerar relatórios de inteligência de vendas para apoiar decisões do time de marketing;
* Atuar como ponte entre Marketing e Vendas, garantindo alinhamento e eficiência na geração e conversão de leads;
* Implementar e disseminar técnicas comerciais avançadas como SPIN Selling, BANT, EMBANTY, entre outras;
* Monitorar e otimizar o uso do CRM (conhecimento em RD Station será um diferencial);
* Garantir a correta nutrição, qualificação e acompanhamento dos leads ao longo do funil.

*Requisitos:*

* Experiência comprovada com liderança de times de vendas e/ou pré-vendas;
* Conhecimento avançado em processos comerciais e técnicas de vendas consultivas;
* Domínio em CRMs de mercado (preferência por RD Station CRM);
* Vivência com metodologias como SPIN, BANT, EMBANTY e similares;
* Capacidade de leitura analítica de dados comerciais e geração de relatórios gerenciais;
* Excelente comunicação, organização e postura de liderança.

*Diferenciais:*

* Experiência anterior em empresas de saúde com vendas de tickets acima de R$ 10 mil;
* Certificações em metodologias de vendas (ex.: Receita Previsível, Inside Sales, Outbound Marketing);
* Vivência com automações de marketing e integração CRM-Marketing.

Além da remuneração fixa, a empresa oferece bônus por performance + VT + VR

Diferencial:

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia Civil e afins;

title: National Sales Manager
description:
About Convatec

Pioneering trusted medical solutions to improve the lives we touch: Convatec is a global medical products and technologies company, focused on solutions for the management of chronic conditions, with leading positions in Advanced Wound Care, Ostomy Care, Continence Care, and Infusion Care. With more than 10,000 colleagues, we provide our products and services in around 90 countries, united by a promise to be forever caring. Our solutions provide a range of benefits, from infection prevention and protection of at‑risk skin, to improved patient outcomes and reduced care costs. Convatec’s revenues in 2024 were over $2 billion. The company is a constituent of the FTSE 100 Index (LSE:CTEC). To learn more please visit

About the role

Responsible for leading the commercial strategy and sales team across the national territory, ensuring the achievement of revenue, profitability, and market share goals. Operates with an analytical and strategic mindset, connecting planning and execution with a focus on sustainable results, development of high‑performance teams, and excellence in relationships with key clients in both public and private sectors.

Key Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the national team of regional managers and sales representatives, ensuring high performance, engagement, and alignment with corporate goals.
  • Plan and execute the Annual Operating Plan (AOP), translating business strategies into tangible and measurable commercial initiatives.
  • Monitor commercial performance indicators (sell‑in, sell‑out, margin, coverage, forecast accuracy, profitability, and compliance) analytically, proposing corrective and preventive actions.
  • Manage and strengthen relationships with strategic clients — including hospital networks, health insurers, distributors, and public institutions — ensuring excellence in negotiation and execution.
  • Ensure strong presence in both public and private channels, with deep understanding of purchasing dynamics, bidding processes, and commercial policies of each segment.
  • Operate with in-depth knowledge of the medical device distributor market, developing sustainable partnerships and ensuring product coverage and availability.
  • Collaborate closely with Marketing, Market Access, Supply Chain, Finance, and Legal to ensure integrated execution of strategies.
  • Anticipate market trends and propose initiatives for commercial expansion, innovation, and competitiveness.
  • Ensure compliance with corporate policies, regulatory standards, and the organization’s ethical guidelines.

Skills and Experience

  • Inspirational leadership and focus on talent development.
  • Strategic mindset with strong execution capabilities.
  • Clear communication, empathy, and positive influence.
  • Results‑oriented and accountable.
  • Collaborative spirit and resilience in the face of complex challenges.
  • Ethics, integrity, and alignment with corporate values.

Qualifications and Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Economics, Engineering, Pharmacy, or related fields.
  • MBA or Postgraduate degree in Commercial Management, Strategy, or Leadership (preferred).
  • Strong experience in commercial leadership roles within multinational companies, preferably in the medical devices, pharmaceutical, or hospital sectors.
  • Fluent English (mandatory).
  • Strong analytical and strategic skills, with mastery of commercial management indicators and tools.
  • Proven experience in people management and leadership of national teams.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and communicate effectively in matrix environments.
  • Advanced knowledge of the public market (bidding processes, DGAC, municipalities, states, Ministry of Health) and private market (hospital networks, insurers, and clinics).
  • Deep experience in managing and developing medical device distributors.
  • Availability for frequent travel.

What you’ll get

  • Competitive salary + bonus
  • Training & development
  • Collaborative, supportive culture

Ready to join us?

At Convatec, we’re pioneering trusted medical solutions to improve the lives we touch. If you’re ready to make a real impact, apply today and help us bring our Forever Caring promise to life.

title: Sr Data Scientist
description:
Description

Ria Money Transfer, a business segment of Euronet Worldwide, Inc. (NASDAQ : EEFT), delivers innovative financial services including fast, secure, and affordable global money transfers to millions of customers along with currency exchange, mobile top-up, bill payment and check cashing services, offering a reliable omnichannel experience. With over 600,000 locations in nearly 200 countries and territories, our purpose remains to open ways for a better everyday life.

We believe we can create a world in which people are empowered to build the life they dream of, no matter who they are or where they are. One customer, one family, one community at a time.

ABOUT THIS POSITION

We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist to join our Data Science team. You will play an integral part of the team, providing analytical excellence which will drive both Ria and XE’s strategy. At both Ria and XE, your contributions can be appreciated by millions of people around the world; therefore, we are looking for someone who is determined to show the world the power of applied analytics.

The ideal candidate will be passionate about asking and answering questions in large and complex datasets, and you can communicate that passion to business owners and other staff, then, this is the role for you.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop and deploy machine learning models and statistical analyses to support business objectives.
  • Design and document end-to-end analytical workflows and process maps for scalable data science solutions.
  • Build decision engines and rule-based systems to automate and optimize business decisions.
  • Define, monitor, and report on KPIs for ML products, ensuring alignment with business goals.
  • Create and maintain dashboards to visualize model performance, business impact, and operational metrics.
  • Conduct exploratory data analysis, hypothesis testing, and model validation.
  • Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into data-driven solutions.
  • Mentor junior data scientists and contribute to best practices in experimentation, reproducibility, and model governance.
  • Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Stay current with emerging trends and technologies in data science and AI.
  • Work on projects such as supervised & unsupervised model development.
  • Own analytical frameworks that guide the product roadmap.
  • Design rigorous experiments and interpret results to draw detailed and actionable conclusions.
  • Develop statistical models to extract trends, measure results, and predict future performance of our products and services.
  • Build simulations to project impact of various product and policy interventions.
  • Enable objective decision-making across the company by democratizing data through dashboards and other analytical tools.
  • Use expertise in causal inference, machine learning, complex systems modeling, behavioral decision theory etc. to shape the future of Ria and Xe.
  • Present findings in a compelling way to influence leadership.
  • Support other projects as directed by more senior staff.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Business acumen – understands key challenges facing our business and partners with key stakeholders to find creative ways to apply data science to solve them.
  • Analytical skills – identify, measure, and impact the important metrics needed to manage and monitor data quality; able to simplify complex content.
  • Attention to detail – appropriately checks all work for errors and does not let important details slip when it comes to data and its accuracy.
  • Creative problem solving – able to use creativity and curiosity as tools to pick apart any problem, producing a solution which is relevant and realistic.
  • Efficiency – able to quickly iterate on data generation and refinement. Look for ways to improve processes to maximize efficiency and remove redundancy.
  • Proactivity – acts without being told what to do at each step; generates novel ideas and processes to drive the business and team forward.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Advanced Degree (e.g., MS, PhD, or MBA) in quantitative fields such as Data Science, computer science, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research or Engineering.
  • Advanced experience developing Machine learning models (supervised, unsupervised).
  • Knowledge of a variety of machine learning techniques (clustering, decision tree learning, artificial neural networks, etc.) and their real-world advantages / drawbacks.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and PySpark. Comfortable in version control tools such as Git and knowledge of cloud environments such as AWS.
  • Experienced in working in Big Data Analytical environments / technologies (Hadoop, Spark).
  • Ability to write complex, efficient, and eloquent SQL queries to extract data.
  • 7+ years of related industry experience.
  • Excellent knowledge of SQL / NoSQL, comfortable working with relational / nonrelational data models.
  • Experience in ML Operations and model deployment is a definite asset.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English.
  • Highly self-motivated and directed.
  • Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment.
  • Ability to travel upon request.

PREFERRED SKILLS

  • Experience with MLOps and deploying models in production environments.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure).
  • Understanding of data governance, privacy, and ethical AI.
  • Experience working in cross-functional product teams.

PERKS & BENEFITS

  • Annual Salary Increase Review
  • 30 Days of Vacation Per Year
  • Comprehensive Insurance Coverage ( Health, Oncological, Dental, and Life Insurance)
  • Meal Allowance
  • English Course Subsidy / Language Assistance
  • Growth Opportunities

title: Head of Brand, Marketing and Promotion
description:
Job Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”), which for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Position Overview

The Head of Brand & Marketing at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil (TM), will be tasked to guide and implement brand and marketing plans, campaigns and activations in line with the marketing & communication strategy. This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as an extension to, and be part of the global MBBI (Marketing, Brand, Business Intelligence) team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines, for being a key representative to all Brand, Marketing and Promotion Tournament matters.
  • Responsible for all promotional aspects including any communications designed and required to support the commercial and marketing objectives of the tournament.
  • Be the main liaison for Host Country and Host City representatives, tournament executive leadership representing the MBBI team.
  • Lead the local, regional and national delivery of various marketing campaigns and initiatives related to, and beyond identified tournament milestones.
  • Lead a team of brand & marketing professionals on the ground, and ensure seamless cooperation, collaboration and integration with all relevant functional areas at FWWC27 LTDA and FIFA’s head office in Zurich, as well as any other functional areas such as legal, finance, etc.
  • Identify and communicate opportunities to create dedicated local, regional or national promotional activities that support the objectives of the tournament, the marketing strategy, or any relevant stakeholders such as commercial partners, media partners, host cities, and others.
  • Identify and drive commercial value through the marketing of the tournament’s brand assets and intellectual property, including but not limited to mascots, licensing & retail, the FIFA Fan Festival, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Trophy Tour, official music tracks/album/sonic identities, and other.
  • Contribute to, and drive implementation of ticketing & hospitality go-to-market strategy and activations plans.
  • Establish and maintain strong and impactful relationships with relevant partners, celebrities, influencers, key event organizers, agencies, etc.
  • Manage and maintain budget and liaise with the relevant colleagues in Zurich in all matters budget and spend.
  • Oversee the correct implementation and utilization of all in-market tournament brand asset implementations and applications including, but not limited to, event and stadium dressing, experiential marketing applications, retail branding, and any other use of the brand assets by FIFA’s internal and external stakeholders.
  • Manage procurement and legal processes (in compliance with FWWC27 LTDA policies and guidelines) as it relates to the tendering and contracting of local, regional or national suppliers, service providers, agencies, and other.
  • Manage and deliver all necessary reporting measures related to the tournament.
  • Drive and manage effective communications between the relevant functional areas and, in particular with the MBBI team in Zurich.

Your Profile

  • Bachelor’s degree or similar higher education in marketing, or a marketing related discipline.
  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in a relevant leadership position.
  • Proven experience delivering major brand & marketing plans.
  • Experience in the sports and/or entertainment industry is a major plus.
  • Experience working in a global or international environment.
  • Proven track record in managing a team in a matrix or similar structure.
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills and the ability to manage up, down and sideways.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Profound knowledge of Brazilian and South American markets and culture.
  • Ability to work to deadlines and stress resilient.
  • Financial and budget management.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Additional Information

  • Seniority level: Mid-Senior level
  • Employment type: Contract
  • Job function: Marketing and Sales

Referrals increase your chances of interviewing at FIFA Women’s World Cup™ by 2x.

Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Data Science at TRACTIAN

The Data Science team at TRACTIAN focuses on extracting valuable insights from vast amounts of industrial data. Using advanced statistical methods, algorithms, and data visualization techniques, this team transforms raw data into actionable intelligence that drives decision-making across engineering, product development, and operational strategies. The team constantly works on optimizing prediction models, identifying trends, and providing data-driven solutions that directly enhance the company’s operational efficiency and the quality of its products.

What you’ll do

We’re hiring a Mid-Level Machine Learning Engineer to bridge the gap between data science and production systems. You’ll own end-to-end deployment of machine learning models, work with real-time sensor data, and build reliable services that power diagnostics for industrial equipment. This is a hands-on role with real impact, ideal for engineers who want to grow their systems design and ML Ops skills.

title: Tax Manager
description:
Overview

The ideal candidate will be responsible for overseeing all tax related decisions and activities in the organization. You will help us stay tax-compliant and up-to-date on new tax laws. And if you can provide accounting expertise to Brazilian small- and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), it'll be better. So that, they can prepare accurate statutory financial statements under Brazilian GAAP (CPC), meet all federal, state and municipal tax obligations, and remain audit-ready at minimal cost.

Key Responsibilities

  • Compute and file monthly IRPJ, CSLL, PIS, COFINS (non-cumulative or cumulative), and ICMS/IPI/ISS as applicable.
  • Prepare and transmit SPED Fiscal, SPED Contábil, ECF, DCTF and DACON via government portals.
  • Monitor e-invoice (NF-e) issuance, validate tax codes, and reconcile to GL.
  • Calculate payroll taxes (INSS, FGTS, IRRF), 13th salary, vacation accruals and severance provisions.
  • Ensure eSocial and RAIS filings are complete and on time.
  • Represent the company before federal, state and municipal tax authorities; manage small audits and refund claims.
  • Provide ad-hoc advice on business restructurings, new product lines or cross-border transactions.

Statutory Accounting & Reporting

  • Maintain complete bookkeeping in compliance with Brazilian GAAP (CPC) and prepare monthly trial balances, balance sheets, income statements and cash-flow statements.
  • Generate year-end statutory financial statements ready for external auditor review and filing with the Junta Comercial.
  • Map IFRS vs. CPC differences and explain impacts to owners/investors in plain language.
  • Implement or optimise cloud accounting packages (QuickBooks Online, ContaAzul, Omie, ERPNext, SAP Business One).
  • Automate recurring journal entries, bank reconciliations and tax filings.

Job Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or Tax; active CRC registration.
  • 4+ years preparing full-cycle statutory accounts and tax returns for Brazilian SMEs.
  • Deep working knowledge of IRPJ, CSLL, ICMS, IPI, ISS, PIS/COFINS regimes and SPED suites.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one local cloud-accounting or ERP system and government tax software (PGDAS, Sicalc, SPED).
  • Fluent Portuguese; conversational English preferred.

description:
DoorDash is building the world's most reliable on-demand, logistics engine for delivery! We're looking for experienced engineers to join our fast-growing engineering team to help us develop a 24x7, global infrastructure system that powers DoorDash's three-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and dashers.

And now, with our new São Paulo office, we offer an unique opportunity for fast tracking your career by experiencing an early venture and help DoorDash grow from a small team to one of the largest engineering hubs in the world.

About the Role

Our software engineers work at the intersection of product and infrastructure to solve key business problems with elegant technical solutions. You'll operate our backend services and architecture that support all product functionality and will be challenged to consider the big picture -- collaborating cross-functionally, as well as evaluating and executing on trade-offs to maximize business impact for the company.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Develop, release and run large-scale web applications
  • Develop and define the backend architecture and tech stack for a product area
  • Improve performance, reliability, scalability and security for our backend systems
  • Be involved in transitioning our monolithic codebase to a microservice-based architecture
  • Completely disrupt logistics by tackling bleeding-edge, technical problems

We're excited about you because you have…

  • B.S., M.S., or PhD. in Computer Science or equivalent
  • 8+ years of industry experience
  • Prior experience working with backend tech stacks
  • Ability to analyze and improve efficiency, scalability, and stability of various system resources
  • Experience with service oriented architecture, writing REST API's, unit testing, and architectural design
  • Understanding of modern web stacks and architecture (HTTP, REST)
  • Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases and other technologies (e.g. Postgres, Redis, Kafka, Spark, S3)

Nice To Haves

  • Experience building large scale, real-time applications
  • Experience with Java/Kotlin
  • Contributor to open source projects

title: Solutions Architect - Mobility Integrations
description:
Solutions Architect - Mobility Integrations

About the company

If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.

We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don't even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay).

To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more.

Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.

About the team/role

Our technical team is the engine that powers our most innovative partnerships. We are the bridge between 99's platform and the outside world, designing and implementing the integrations that make ambitious ideas a reality. As a Solutions Architect, you will be the lead technical expert for Brazil, architecting API integrations with public and private entities and building automations that streamline our business processes. This role is crucial for our expansion into MaaS and beyond.

In this role, you'll be...

Leading the technical discovery and design for integrations with external partners, primarily focusing on REST/SOAP APIs.

Architecting robust, scalable, and secure integration solutions that connect 99's platform with third-party systems.

Developing business process automations using both front-end and back-end technologies to improve internal efficiency and partnership operations.

Acting as the primary technical liaison between Brazilian partners and our global Product Management teams in China, requiring excellent English communication skills.

Writing clear technical documentation, specifications, and diagrams to guide development and ensure alignment across all teams.

Troubleshooting complex technical issues during and after implementation, providing expert guidance to ensure project success.

We're eager to be in touch because you have...

5+ years of experience in a technical role such as Solutions Architect, API Specialist, Integration Engineer, or Full-Stack Developer.

Deep, hands-on expertise in designing and consuming APIs (REST, SOAP) and working with common data formats (JSON, XML).

Excellent professional proficiency in English, with the ability to clearly communicate complex technical concepts to international teams.

A problem-solver's mindset, with the ability to analyze complex systems and design elegant, effective solutions. Experience with public transport data standards (GTFS/GTFS-RT) is a major bonus.

You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value. We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven. We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration. Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity. Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth. We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion. Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a vision of the future or something we wish to have one day, it is a non-negotiable value of who we are.

We practice inclusion, plurality, and respect. And we count on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works together with HR, leadership and identity groups - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres, and 99Mamães. This part of our journey has been written, there remains a long road before us.

We reinforce that this position is open to everyone, including pregnant people and people with disabilities (PwD).

Sobre o Stark Bank

No Stark Bank, somos mais que um banco digital para empresas: somos parceiros estratégicos que, desde 2018, vêm redefinindo o futuro dos serviços financeiros corporativos no Brasil. Oferecemos uma gama completa de serviços, desde o processamento ágil de pagamentos e faturas até a gestão inteligente de contas a receber, tudo integrado e automatizado através de uma API robusta e inovadora. Não nos contentamos em apenas otimizar processos; ambicionamos nos tornar o maior banco em tecnologia financeira, capacitando negócios a prosperarem com soluções que eliminam burocracias e impulsionam a eficiência.

Acreditamos que a chave para revolucionar o sistema financeiro reside na nossa busca incessante por inovação e na nossa capacidade de transformar problemas complexos em soluções impactantes. Cada linha de código, cada nova funcionalidade que desenvolvemos, é destinada a permitir que as empresas foquem no que realmente importa: estratégia e crescimento.

Nosso legado é ambicioso: construir o melhor ecossistema bancário em tecnologia e atendimento para empresas no Brasil. E para alcançar essa visão, precisamos de mentes curiosas, persistentes e apaixonadas por desafios. Se você se identifica com a minuciosidade, consistência e persistência que nos movem, se acredita na melhoria constante e coloca o cliente no centro de suas ações, e se busca um ambiente colaborativo e desafiador onde a ambição encontra a oportunidade de escalar, o Stark Bank é o seu lugar.

Sobre o Squad de Issuing

A Squad de Issuing é responsável por desenvolver e manter toda a infraestrutura de cartões do Stark Bank, tanto físicos quanto virtuais. Nossa missão é oferecer aos clientes uma experiência de emissão, controle e uso de cartões que seja intuitiva, segura e confiável. Atuamos com foco em escalabilidade, segurança e integração com o ecossistema financeiro — desde bandeiras (como Mastercard) até processadoras e plataformas de tokenização como Apple Pay e Google Pay.

O Desafio

Como engenheiro(a) de software sênior na Squad de Issuing, você terá papel central no desenvolvimento de APIs e sistemas que possibilitam a emissão, gestão e uso de cartões por nossos clientes. O desafio envolve construir soluções resilientes que operam em tempo real, garantindo a segurança e performance de transações sensíveis, integrando múltiplas camadas do ecossistema de pagamentos e contribuindo diretamente para a evolução do produto cartão.

Você irá:

  • Projetar e escalar APIs para emissão, ativação, bloqueio, tokenização e uso de cartões;
  • Integrar com bandeiras (como Mastercard) e processadoras de cartão via mensageria segura (ex: ISO 8583, APIs REST, webhooks);
  • Construir sistemas com fluxos de autorização, antifraude, retentativas e reconciliação automática de transações;
  • Implementar tokenização de cartões (Apple Pay, Google Pay) e autenticação segura (3DS, OTP);
  • Desenvolver soluções que permitam controle granular dos cartões (limites, tipos de uso, bloqueios temporários, alertas);
  • Atuar com foco em observabilidade, performance e segurança para ambientes de alta criticidade;
  • Participar de war rooms, atuando na análise de incidentes e resolução de falhas em produção;
  • Escrever código robusto, legível e de fácil manutenção.

Esperamos que você:

  • Tenha sólida experiência em back-end e construção de sistemas distribuídos;
  • Conheça práticas de menssageria assíncrona e arquitetura orientada a eventos;
  • Tenha experiência com produtos financeiros, especialmente meios de pagamento ou cartões;
  • Esteja familiarizado com SLAs rigorosos, ambientes de alta transação e baixa latência;
  • Pratique princípios de DevOps e tenha domínio sobre monitoramento, logging e segurança;
  • Tenha atenção a requisitos regulatórios (ex: PCI-DSS) e boas práticas de criptografia;
  • Traduza requisitos de produto e regras complexas em soluções técnicas simples e escaláveis.

O que aumenta suas chances:

  • Experiência com protocolos como ISO 8583 ou conhecimento sobre tokenização de cartões;
  • Vivência com integrações com bandeiras e processadoras (ex: Dock, Pismo, Fiserv);
  • Conhecimento de PCI-DSS, criptografia, e segurança de dados sensíveis;
  • Experiência com sistemas de autorização em tempo real e mecanismos antifraude;
  • Atuação prévia em fintechs ou bancos digitais, especialmente com foco em cartões.

O Que Oferecemos:

No Stark Bank, investimos no seu sucesso e acreditamos em um ambiente de trabalho onde você pode prosperar. Além de um ambiente desafiador e inovador, oferecemos:

Nossos benefícios

Salário mensal atrativo comparado ao mercado.

Bônus anual, reconhecendo suas conquistas e o seu impacto.

Auxílio moradia (conforme política de distância do escritório).

Creditas para te ajudar a alcançar seus objetivos financeiros.

Inglês in-company para impulsionar seu desenvolvimento profissional.

Seguro de vida para sua tranquilidade e da sua família.
