title: OPERADOR ARMAZENAGEM II
description:
Descrição da empresa

Você conhece a LDC? A LDC é uma das principais comercializadoras e processadoras global de produtos agrícolas, com um portfólio diversificado, que abrange toda a cadeia de valor, da originação à distribuição. Com atividades no centro da produção agrícola e de alimentos e guiados pelos nossos fortes valores, por um legado rico e uma visão clara, estamos comprometidos em trabalhar por um futuro seguro e sustentável. Ajudamos a alimentar e vestir cerca de 500 milhões de pessoas todos os anos, originando, processando e transportando aproximadamente 81 milhões de toneladas de produtos. Estruturada como uma organização matricial de 6 regiões geográficas e 10 plataformas, a LDC está ativa em mais de 100 países e emprega cerca de 18.000 pessoas em todo o mundo. Somos guiados por valores que norteiam todos os públicos em nosso trabalho. A ética e integridade fazem parte de todas as relações de negócio, assim como a humildade, comprometimento e diversidade.

Descrição da vaga

  • Amostra de coleta, homogenizar e realizar a classificação das amostras conforme manual de classificação da LDC, apontando o limite da percentagem de cada item de classificação (umidade, impureza, avariados, grãos verdes, ardidos, queimados e quebrados);
  • Monitorar via supervisório e em campo as variáveis de processo, controlando cargas, amperagens, temperaturas, depressões e níveis, para realizar de forma segura o processo de secagem de graõs;
  • Monitorar a entrada e saída de grãos dos secadores, através da análise de umidade para checar a temperatura necessária para a secagem dos grãos;
  • Acompanhar a temperatura dos secadores e realizar abastecimento das fornalhas com lenha, quando necessário;
  • Facilitar o fluxo na descarga de caminhões, regulando a carga de abastecimento dos secadores de acordo com os parâmetros das variáveis acima citadas;
  • Monitorar a temperatura do produto estocado nos armazéns, gerar relatórios de termometria para analisar a necessidade de forçar aeração ou remoção dos grãos e tomar as devidas providências, informando o Supervisor de Armazenagem e Gerência quando necessário;
  • Monitorar o processo de limpeza da soja, regulando cargas nas peneiras, limpeza nas telas do equipamento;
  • Acompanhar o abastecimento dos armazéns, controlar os pontos de entrada e retirada de produto, para evitar derramamentos e remoção de pontos indevidos;
  • Manter a área de trabalho limpa e organizada, seguindo as Instruções de Trabalho, cronogramas de limpeza e demais orientações dos programas implantados na unidade;
  • Monitorar os pontos de controle, realizar corretamente o preenchimento das planilhas, tomando as providências necessárias e informando ao Supervisor quando necessário;
  • Empurrar produtos no armazém para as bicas de saída utilizando a pá carregadeira;

Qualificações

Ensino médio completo.

Informações adicionais

Diversidade, Inclusão e Equidade

A diversidade é parte do nosso DNA. A LDC busca sempre criar um ambiente de trabalho diversificado e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas possam prosperar. Respeitamos e valorizamos talentos de todos os gêneros, idades, raças, etnias, sexualidades, religiões e deficiências. Diversidade é um de nossos valores! Essa oportunidade destina-se também às pessoas com deficiências (PcD).

Sustentabilidade

O valor sustentável está no centro de nosso propósito como empresa.

Somos apaixonados pela criação de valor justo e sustentável, tanto para nossos negócios quanto para outros stakeholders da cadeia de valor: nosso pessoal, nossos parceiros comerciais, as comunidades e o meio ambiente ao nosso redor.

El nuevo Country Manager de Brasil continuará con la misma dirección de actuación que Ríos ha diseñado para el mercado brasileño, una dirección que asegura la alineación del Clúster y la cultura empresarial de GN.

En estos 7 años hemos construido confianza y comunidad : más de 60 mil créditos otorgados y más de 24 mil vehículos entregados en Chile, México y Colombia.

The Chief Seller Officer will be responsible for driving the development of our Seller Business Unit, increasing our share of wallet and margin per seller by deploying new solutions and increasing engagement to positivly impact our Galgo.com business.   • MBA from a top global university is a plus

Nice-to-have

title: AI Augmented Software Engineer Senior
description:
PALO IT is a global technology consultancy that crafts tech as a force for good. We design, develop and scale digital and sustainable products and services to unlock value across the triple bottom line: people, planet, profit. We do the right thing, we do it right. We’re proud to be a World Economic Forum New Champion, and a B Corp-certified company.

We are small enough to care locally, big enough to deliver globally (5 continents, 18 offices, +650 experts from +50 nationalities)

We are robust and resilient (100% independent and 0 debt)

We are entrepreneurs and passionate experts: We invest in what we believe genuinely and work as a collective intelligence

We are positive, courageous, caring, doers and committed to excellence

About Gen-e2

While the market is still largely AI-augmenting delivery, we have reinvented the SDLC to be AI First. Our approach is a game-changer in productivity and quality, with a strong collaboration between IA generative and our best Talents:

We now generate 95% of the entire product — code, documentation, infrastructure as code, and even design — with GitHub Copilot.

The quality consistently exceeds the output of our best traditional engineering teams.

A product repository houses all product artefacts, giving AI full project context for higher-quality generation.

A library of rules and prompts defines coding standards, design principles, and security guidelines, ensuring enterprise-grade quality and scalability.

With Gen-e2, we deliver end-to-end products 2–3× faster than traditional approaches, while raising the bar for engineering excellence.

Your Role

You will leverage your software development expertise and cutting-edge AI tools to accelerate development cycles and drive innovation. As a key member of our team, you will apply your skills in software development, application architecture, and problem-solving to build rapid prototypes and production-ready solutions. You'll use AI-powered development tools to improve code quality, automate daily tasks, and speed up delivery—while maintaining high engineering standards.

Working closely with project teams and business stakeholders, you’ll bring your technical expertise to catalyze innovation using both traditional development practices and AI-augmented environments.

Your soft skills will help you build or be part of a high-performing engineering team that consistently exceeds expectations by effectively combining human expertise and AI capabilities.

Your Mission

As a tech consultant , your mission is both external and internal .

Externally, with clients, you will:

  • Write code following best practices and a software craftsmanship mindset—augmented by AI
  • Proactively suggest, test, and adapt tools and methods that best fit the context of your assignment
  • Conduct code, accessibility, performance, and security audits using both your expertise and AI-assisted analysis
  • Listen, rephrase, create diagrams, lead workshops... in short, do everything to ensure ongoing mutual understanding
  • Participate in, facilitate, and/or organize Agile ceremonies in your projects
  • Suggest improvements to your client and team members for better ways of working
  • Design simple, scalable architectures adapted to various contexts using AI-driven approaches
  • Leverage AI tools to troubleshoot and efficiently solve technical problems
  • Stay up to date with emerging technologies and AI development practices

Internally, at PALO IT, within the Tech Hive , you will:

  • Join our internal technical community (experience sharing, tech watch, support)
  • Collaborate with colleagues on process and/or tool improvement initiatives
  • Take part in our training and positive-impact workshops: sustainable tech, climate fresk, 2tonnes, accessibility, etc.

Examples of Projects We’ve Done

  • Developed an app to manage a company’s fleet of electric cars
  • Built a SaaS platform for the circular economy to support tool reuse
  • Created an app to optimize the yield of a pepper farm in Cambodia
  • Carried out technical, organizational, and UX audits—paired up—at a VR software publisher and a wine industry client
  • Designed and facilitated workshops on sustainable tech and accessibility; led 2tonnes workshops

Your Profile

Our consultants come from very diverse backgrounds, and we’re proud of that richness. Describing our future colleague could take hours, so here are a few key points:

  • You’re technologically agnostic and enjoy discovering and implementing new tech stacks
  • You are proactive, curious , and open to different perspectives and backgrounds
  • You are skilled in using AI code assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Continue, Code Assist, Cursor…) for code generation and problem-solving
  • You understand fast engineering principles for optimal interaction with AI tools
  • You have a critical mindset to validate and verify AI-generated code and solutions
  • You are committed to continuous learning and keeping up with the fast-evolving AI landscape
  • You are open to cross-functional roles when project quality requires it
  • You care about social and environmental issues and Tech for Good
  • You value the social and environmental impacts of what you build

More About PALO IT

We’re eager to adapt to change, learn from our experiences and move to meet our planet’s urgent needs. We are continuously taking action to:

  • Deliver projects with a positive impact
  • Train 100% of our workforce on impact
  • Achieve B Corp certification among all our offices across the globe
  • Continuously measure & improve employee happiness

Our clients are amongst the world’s most successful companies. We innovate with both established Fortune 1000s, SMEs and start-ups who aim to make an impact, become global leaders and address the world’s most complex challenges.

What We Offer

  • Stimulating working environments
  • Unique career path
  • International mobility
  • Internal R&D projects
  • Knowledge sharing
  • Personalized training

For more on our team culture and benefits, check out our careers page and our PALOCast with testimonies from our Palowans!

Você está em busca de uma carreira com grandes desafios? É curioso(a) e persistente? Você quer se desenvolver em um ambiente inovador, onde experimentamos coisas novas e sonhamos grande? Quer fazer parte do futuro da computação em nuvem com uma equipe obcecada por ajudar os clientes?
Se sim, junte-se à nossa equipe AWS no Brasil como Arquiteto (a) de Soluções e ajude nossos clientes a mudarem o mundo! A AWS é a plataforma de nuvem mais adotada e mais abrangente do mundo, suportando milhões de clientes, incluindo startups, grandes empresas e órgãos governamentais.
Nesta função, sua criatividade conectará tecnologia a problemas de negócio através de soluções tangíveis. Você terá a oportunidade de aprender novas habilidades e aprimorar as suas existentes. Você criará e compartilhará conteúdo técnico, arquiteturas de referência e práticas recomendadas. Esperamos de você motivação, trabalho em colaboração com pessoas ao redor do mundo, disposição para enfrentar desafios, paixão pelo que faz e se divertir ao fazê-lo. Você deve gostar de estudar e se desenvolver, desenhar e criar soluções em nuvem para um conjunto diversificado e desafiador de clientes.

Key job responsibilities
Arquiteto (a) de soluções têm 4 responsabilidades principais:
1. Atuar como consultor para clientes . Em parceria com a equipe de contas, formular e executar uma estratégia para viabilizar o sucesso do cliente. Ajudar os clientes a adotar os serviços da AWS e fazer o melhor uso deles, gerando receita como resultado. Educar os clientes sobre a proposta de valor da AWS e participar de discussões de arquitetura para garantir que as soluções sejam desenhadas para uma implantação bem-sucedida na nuvem. Criar confiança com indivíduos técnicos dentro dos clientes para que sejam cloud advocates.
2. Ser referência técnica . Transferir conhecimento para os clientes. Capturar e compartilhar conhecimento e boas práticas na comunidade de arquitetura de soluções da AWS. Contribuir com publicações para o cliente da AWS, como whitepapers, postagens ou blogs. Apresentar e contribuir em workshops, grupos de usuários, vídeos online e conferências.
3. Estar em crescimento profissional contínuo . Ter curiosidade e se manter aprendendo. Demonstrar seu aprendizado através das Certificações da AWS. Trabalhar com outras pessoas para ajudá-las a entregar mais. Participar de encontros e conferências.
4. Desenvolver e executar melhorias organizacionais . Atuar como um elo técnico entre os clientes e as equipes de engenharia de serviços para melhorar os serviços e recursos da AWS. Contribuir com suas ideias para inovação para times internos e clientes. Simplificar processos que podem ser simplificados. Ajudar a contratar e desenvolver talentos.
About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

- Ability to communicate effectively in English (both written and verbal) in business settings.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience in technology/software sales, pre-sales, or consulting

- Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
- Experience with AWS technologies

description:
We are a global digital agency composed of strategists, creatives, media experts, data scientists, and engineers driven by one common purpose — accelerate business growth through marketing and digital transformation. Named a top 3% Google Premier Partner and recognized by Inc. 5000 and Adweek’s 75 Fastest Growing Companies, we’re constantly looking for “A” players to join our team.

The rapid growth is attributed to our strongest asset — our people. Our teams are highly collaborative and work closely with each client to set clear goals and objectives so that we can deliver exceptional results. Mindgruve is a place where every opinion is valued. Not only will you be empowered to contribute ideas, but you will also play a key role in the execution and driving success for brands across a variety of industries. Sounds fun? Perfect — you’ll fit right in.

The Data Scientist plays a key role in delivering, maintaining, and evolving our data science solutions for clients. This position blends hands-on analytics, applied machine learning, and software development in a fast-paced, client-facing environment. The primary responsibility is to fit, run, maintain, and configure our suite of data science models and pipelines for clients, while also taking on ad hoc analytical projects and contributing to our shared solution code base when capacity allows.
This is a hybrid role—part data scientist as an analyst, part developer, and part researcher. You’ll work closely with internal teams and some of the world’s leading brands to test, refine, and operationalize models that drive meaningful business outcomes. When not actively engaged in client delivery, you’ll contribute to our internal development efforts by improving productized data science tools, frameworks, and automation capabilities.
The role offers a unique opportunity to gain broad exposure across the full data science lifecycle—from research and experimentation to deployment, performance monitoring, and ongoing model enhancement. It’s designed for someone eager to deepen both their technical and business acumen, expand their experience across diverse use cases, and prepare for advancement into a Senior Data Scientist position.

What You’ll Do Here:

  • Fit, run, maintain, and contribute to the build of proprietary machine learning models including:
    • Marketing and Media Mix.
    • Performance Forecasting.
    • Price Elasticity.
    • Competitive Pricing.
    • Merchandising Optimization.
    • Audience Segmentation.
    • Lift Studies.
  • Collaborate with Sr. Data Scientists, ML Operations Engineers, and Data engineers to support the build and validation of enterprise data science solutions.
  • Collaborate with marketing and strategy teams to understand client needs and translate them into data science problems.
  • Design and conduct lift studies to validate hypotheses and measure the impact of our solutions.
  • Create insightful visualizations to communicate findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in machine learning and data science, and propose innovative solutions to improve our offerings.

We Need a Person With:

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • Strong proficiency in Python, with experience using common Data Science libraries such as scikit-learn, PyTorch, Pandas, NumPy, and Matplotlib.
  • Experience with SQL.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team.
  • Adaptability and eagerness to learn in a fast-paced environment.
  • Professional and personal integrity.
  • A detail-oriented mindset, focused on driving results.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

What We Consider a Plus:

  • Experience with MLOps and leading machine learning algorithms like XGBoost, Neural Networks, Regression Analysis, etc.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Experience with AWS SageMaker.
  • Experience working in MLOps framework and ability to contribute to the pipeline and collaborate closely with MLOps Engineers.
  • Experience with AI and agentic systems is a plus.

Sales Strategy Manager

Genesys empowers organizations of all sizes to improve loyalty and business outcomes by creating the best experiences for their customers and employees. Through Genesys Cloud, the AI‑powered Experience Orchestration platform, organizations can accelerate growth by delivering empathetic, personalized experiences at scale to drive customer loyalty, workforce engagement, efficiency and operational improvements.

We employ more than 6,000 people across the globe who embrace empathy and cultivate collaboration to succeed. While we offer great benefits and perks like larger tech companies, our employees have the independence to make a larger impact on the company and take ownership of their work. Join the team and create the future of customer experience together.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly strategic and analytically strong Sales Strategy Manager to lead the development, deployment, and optimization of core initiatives that drive performance across our global Direct Sales organization. This role sits at the intersection of strategy design, program leadership, and cross‑functional execution—responsible for creating strategic programs and ensuring they deliver measurable, sustained impact. You will operate as a thought partner to Sales Leadership, drive business‑critical analyses, architect scalable sales programs, and oversee structured execution across multiple teams. This role requires excellent executive communication, strong business judgment, and the ability to independently lead complex, high‑visibility initiatives in a high‑growth SaaS environment.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Program Leadership

  • Own end‑to‑end design and leadership of core Direct Sales programs—from concept creation and modeling to launch, optimization, measurement, and retirement.
  • Facilitate strategic alignment with Sales, Finance, Operations, and GTM leadership to ensure programs accelerate revenue outcomes and seller productivity.
  • Establish program governance, operating cadences, KPIs, communication plans, and stakeholder alignment across global teams.

Analytics & Executive Insight

  • Develop and present executive‑level insights, including performance analysis, predictive modeling, scenario planning, and ROI measurement.
  • Identify structural opportunities (e.g., segmentation, productivity, coverage, prioritization) and build strategic recommendations to influence senior leadership decisions.
  • Define and own the measurement framework for program success, partnering with Revenue Intelligence on dashboards, data quality, and reporting enhancements.

Cross‑Functional Execution & PMO Leadership

  • Lead cross‑functional project management for large‑scale sales initiatives involving Sales, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Enablement, Product, and CS.
  • Ensure launch readiness by coordinating training, communications, workflow design, and system readiness.
  • Champion continuous improvement—driving process modernization, automation opportunities, and operational agility and scalability across programs.

Strategic Projects & Change Leadership

  • Own and deliver global cross‑functional strategic projects that impact sales productivity and revenue acceleration (e.g., pilot designs, territory strategy, quota levers, incentive mechanisms).
  • Guide change management for new sales motions and programs, ensuring adoption, clarity, and consistent execution across the field.
  • Conduct post‑launch evaluations and lead structured optimization cycles or sunsetting of legacy programs.

Qualifications

  • 7–12+ years in Sales Strategy, Revenue Strategy, Sales Operations, or Management Consulting within a SaaS or high‑growth environment.
  • Demonstrated success designing, launching, and managing large‑scale sales programs or strategic initiatives.
  • Strong business acumen with deep understanding of SaaS sales motions, pipeline dynamics, forecasting, and productivity drivers.
  • Advanced analytical capability—expert in Excel/Sheets, Salesforce, and BI tools (Tableau, Power BI).
  • Exceptional executive presentation and communication skills; proven ability to influence senior leaders.
  • Strong project management expertise with experience leading multi‑workstream, cross‑functional initiatives.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or related field (MBA or equivalent preferred).

Preferred Attributes

  • Experience supporting global enterprise sales teams.
  • Proven ability to operate autonomously, set strategic direction, and move initiatives from vision to execution.
  • Skilled at navigating ambiguity, building structure, and driving clarity across complex projects.
  • Passion for operational excellence, analytics, and scalable process design.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Confira o que é preciso.

  • Graduação completa em qualquer área de atuação, preferencialmente em TI;

  • Vivência em empresas de tecnologia e com mercado B2B;

O que é desejável, mas não obrigatório?

O que você irá fazer no seu dia a dia e com o que irá trabalhar?

Se interessou pela SYDLE e pela oportunidade?
Será incrível receber seu currículo e saber do seu interesse pelo nosso time! Cada currículo recebido é avaliado pelo nosso RH e, caso o seu seja selecionado, entraremos em contato convidando para nossa seleção. Então fique de olho no celular e no e-mail, combinado? Mas caso seu currículo não seja selecionado para essa vaga, não se preocupe! Você ficará automaticamente em nosso banco de talentos para oportunidades futuras.

Conte com a SYDLE!
Nossas oportunidades são para pessoas talentosas, independente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, deficiência, classe social ou religião. Queremos crescer juntos e acreditamos que, quanto mais diverso e autêntico for o nosso time, mais rico será o nosso dia a dia. Dessa forma, buscamos ter um olhar diferenciado e cuidadoso para essa pauta nas nossas seleções. E, caso você precise de alguma adaptação especial em nosso processo seletivo ou se tiver dificuldades em custear seu deslocamento para participar das avaliações, conte com a gente e informe o RH ao agendar as etapas.

Confira nossos benefícios!

Cada colaborador tem uma necessidade única. Há quem tenha família grande e queira todo mundo no plano de saúde ou quem já tenha o plano junto com sua família. Também temos aqueles que utilizam transporte público ou que prefiram ir de carro. Há quem prefira comer em restaurantes e quem prefira fazer supermercado para preparar aquela comidinha em casa... Enfim, por que impor benefícios engessados para todos, se as pessoas têm necessidades diferentes? Essa é a SYDLE, uma empresa humana, flexível, preocupada com as necessidades individuais dos seus colaboradores.

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Data Science at TRACTIAN

The Data Science team at TRACTIAN focuses on extracting valuable insights from vast amounts of industrial data. Using advanced statistical methods, algorithms, and data visualization techniques, this team transforms raw data into actionable intelligence that drives decision-making across engineering, product development, and operational strategies. The team constantly works on optimizing prediction models, identifying trends, and providing data-driven solutions that directly enhance the company’s operational efficiency and the quality of its products.

What you'll do

We're seeking an experienced LLM Applications Engineer to design, develop, and deploy production-ready applications that harness the capabilities of large language models. In this role, you'll create robust APIs, implement intelligent information retrieval systems, and build resilient infrastructure that connects AI capabilities with real-world industrial applications.

Responsibilities

  • Design and develop user-facing applications powered by large language models
  • Create and maintain high-performance APIs that integrate LLMs with our platform
  • Implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems for enhanced information access
  • Build intelligent document processing workflows using OCR and LLM technologies
  • Develop conversational interfaces that solve practical problems for our users
  • Ensure system reliability with fallback mechanisms for provider outages
  • Collaborate with product teams to define requirements and technical specifications

Requirements

  • 1-4 years of experience in software engineering with a focus on backend development
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent technical field
  • Demonstrated experience building applications that utilize large language models
  • Strong proficiency in Python and experience with web frameworks like FastAPI, Flask, or Django
  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining production REST APIs
  • Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL
  • Familiarity with LLM orchestration tools such as LangChain or LangGraph
  • Experience with vector embeddings and information retrieval systems
  • History of shipping code to production environments

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with LLM fine-tuning and model optimization techniques
  • Knowledge of containerization and microservices architecture
  • Experience with OCR and document processing technologies
  • Understanding of performance optimization for AI applications

Technical Skills

  • Programming: Python and/or Golang
  • Frameworks: FastAPI, Flask, Django
  • LLM Tools: LangChain, LangGraph
  • API Development: REST, OpenAPI
  • Databases: PostgreSQL, Redis, vector databases
  • LLM Integration: OpenAI, Anthropic, and other providers

  • Arquitetura de Dados (Medallion): Projetar, implementar e manter pipelines de dados escaláveis e eficientes, gerenciando todo o ciclo de vida dos dados através das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold na plataforma Databricks.
  • Desenvolvimento e Otimização de Pipelines: Construir e gerenciar fluxos de ETL/ELT complexos utilizando Azure Databricks (PySpark/SQL) e Azure Data Factory, garantindo a ingestão, transformação e armazenamento robusto dos dados.

  • Integração de Sistemas: Construir e implementar APIs para facilitar a comunicação, ingestão e consumo de dados, garantindo a troca eficiente de informações entre sistemas (ex: Oracle, SQL Server, fontes externas).
  • Colaboração e Governança: Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com equipes multifuncionais (BI, Data Science, Negócios) e aplicar as melhores práticas de engenharia e governança de dados.

Requisitos e Ferramentas Essenciais

  • Experiência Sólida: Experiência como Engenheiro de Dados, com foco principal no ecossistema Azure Cloud.
  • Expertise em Databricks: Conhecimento profundo em Azure Databricks, incluindo Spark, PySpark, Spark SQL e otimização de clusters.

  • Linguagens: Domínio avançado em SQL e Python (voltado para engenharia de dados, ex: Pandas, PySpark).
  • Conceitos Fundamentais: Excelente compreensão dos fluxos de ETL/ELT, arquitetura Medallão (Medallion Architecture) e dos fundamentos do Delta Lake.
  • Modelagem de Dados: Experiência com técnicas de modelagem de dados (dimensional, relacional) e familiaridade com ferramentas como Erwin ou similares.
  • Bancos de Dados: Conhecimento prático em bancos de dados relacionais, como Oracle e SQL Server.

Gerente de Agricultura Regenerativa Cadeia de fornecimento de óleo de palma

Gerente de Agricultura Regenerativa Cadeia de fornecimento de óleo de palma

Trabalhamos com os nossos membros e parceiros para tornar as cadeias de valor um motor de prosperidade para comunidades e ecossistemas, operando diretamente nos territórios. Vemos um mundo no qual as florestas são uma fonte ilimitada de materiais e um lar para a biodiversidade, as comunidades têm direitos respeitados e oportunidades de se desenvolver, os trabalhadores são parceiros produtivos, e a agricultura se torna o instrumento para alimentar um planeta faminto e manter o clima estável.

Sobre o Projeto Carbono

Localizado na Microrregião Tomé-Açu (PA), tem o objetivo de implementar práticas de baixo carbono, na cadeia de produção de óleo de palma de uma empresa local. Por meio de uma abordagem de ambientação climática, visa a gerar reduções e remoções de carbono por meio de quatro intervenções principais: (i) Estabelecimento de Sistemas Agroflorestais (SAFs), (ii) Restauração de áreas degradadas, (iii) Plantio de cultivo intercalar de cacau e palmeira, (iv) Transição para fertilizantes de base orgânica.

Como Gerente de Projetos, você será o(a) principal responsável por:

  • O Gerente de Projeto em Agricultura Regenerativa será responsável pelo planejamento e execução do Plano de Trabalho alinhado à estratégia de Landscape da microrregião de Tomé-Açu, incluindo gestão orçamentária e entrega de metas.
  • Além disso, o(a) gerente será responsável pelo desenvolvimento de diagnósticos, linhas de base e relatórios técnicos, bem como pela liderança na implementação de projetos de agricultura regenerativa, assegurando o cumprimento de prazos e metas estabelecidas. Também atuará na facilitação de capacitações para as equipes da Earthworm Foundation e parceiros, apoiando agricultores na adoção de práticas como sistemas agroflorestais (SAFs) e fertilização orgânica, com foco na redução e remoção de carbono.
  • Sob a supervisão do Líder de Campo, o gerente atuará como principal ponto de contato com parceiros do projeto , incluindo empresas e agricultores, promovendo engajamento contínuo e comunicação clara entre as partes.
  • O(a) gerente também será responsável por organizar visitas técnicas, workshops e eventos de campo, oferecendo suporte logístico e administrativo. Caberá ainda o monitoramento do progresso do projeto por meio da análise de dados, elaboração de relatórios periódicos e sistematização de aprendizados. Espera-se a entrega de estratégias, projetos e protocolos internos desenvolvidos, além da capacitação das equipes e da atuação dos agricultores com práticas regenerativas conforme o planejado.

Condições de trabalho

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciências Agrárias, Engenharia Ambiental ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência: Mínima de 3 anos
  • Idioma(s): Português e Inglês/Espanhol
  • Contrato temporário: 1 ano – Regime CLT (44 horas semanais)
  • Local: Microrregião Tomé-Açu (PA

Você tem as características que buscamos? Confira:

Buscamos uma pessoa proativa e comprometida com resultados, para atuar na cadeia de suprimentos de óleo de palma em Tomé-Açu (PA), com foco na redução de carbono e práticas agrícolas sustentáveis. É importante ter boa comunicação e engajamento com stakeholders, contribuindo para a regeneração de paisagens e a sustentabilidade da região.

Experiência com agricultura sustentável, agroflorestas, fertilização orgânica, restauração de ecossistemas e conhecimento em geoprocessamento são diferenciais. Também valorizamos habilidades de liderança para apoiar agricultores na adoção de práticas de baixo carbono e paixão por agricultura regenerativa.

Se está procurando um propósito e deseja inovar e agir pelo meio ambiente, esta oportunidade é para você! Na Earthworm Foundation , você se juntará a uma equipe comprometida e apaixonada, focada em encontrar soluções concretas. E também descobrirá diversas personalidades, todas determinadas a regenerar ecossistemas.

Se tem interesse nessa aventura, inscreva-se enviando o seu Currículo para nossa equipe no Brasil, aos cuidados de Raquel Costa – - 24/06/2025 , com o assunto "Regenerative Agriculture Manager – 2025".

title: Global Head of Cloud Alliances
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Global Head of Cloud Alliances to lead business development and partnerships with the global public clouds. As the publisher of Ubuntu, Canonical is already a trusted partner with the leading guest OS and select services for the major hyperscalers. We have a large portfolio of open source software on the cloud marketplace for enterprise customers, and are looking to expand our global cloud partnerships.

Reporting to the VP of Global Alliances, the Global Head of Cloud Alliances will lead teams that bring innovation to the public cloud platforms, joint go-to-market with public cloud sales communities and marketplaces, and our global customer and partner contracts. They will work closely with cloud partners, from engineering to product management and marketing, to deliver open source solutions at scale for their cloud customers.

Our Cloud Alliance team builds trusted relationships with partners at all levels, from joint technical work to executive strategy. Their goal is to increase Canonical market share in the cloud ISV ecosystem, develop cloud channel sales, evangelize the partnership and lead all business interactions. The Global Head of Cloud Alliances will own the strategy, sell-to, sell-through and sell-with motions with all cloud partners, as well as promotion of our cloud related activities—from campaigns to strategic opportunities and cloud related events.

Our company is largely distributed, this role can be based anywhere in the Americas or EMEA.

Responsibilities

  • Taking ownership of Canonical's global cloud partner strategy, leading efforts to forecast, driving bookings, and growing revenue worldwide
  • Building strong, cross-functional relationships across teams to ensure a unified approach to technology and market execution
  • Inspiring and guiding teams to achieve accelerated revenue growth with Cloud partners, continually refining and evolving strategies for success
  • Establishing and nurturing executive-level relationships with key partners, laying the foundation for long-term success and mutual growth
  • Steering our offering from concept to execution, aligning product management and marketing strategies while scaling success through our global sales organization

What we are looking for in you

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Leadership and commitment to skills development and mentorship
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Exceptional leadership and presentation skills, capable of energizing teams and stakeholders while delivering compelling data-driven narratives
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite, and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organization
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
  • An in-depth understanding of open source technologies, Ubuntu, and the competitive ecosystem, with an eye for identifying opportunities that others might miss.
  • Autonomous, disciplined, and proactive—take ownership, and deliver exceptional results

Nice to have

  • A track record in alliance and indirect sales management, with an ability to build partnerships that drive success
  • Solid experience in the Public Cloud sector, coupled with an understanding of the evolving landscape of technology and innovation.
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)

What we offer

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

DESIGN

What We Do

Put your design skills to work at a cutting-edge company that challenges the norm. From character and level design to competitive gameplay and system design, help shape the future of interactive entertainment at Epic.

What You’ll Do

Epic Games is looking for a Principal Game Designer to tackle high-level engagement challenges across the Fortnite ecosystem. This includes innovating existing systems like Quests and Passes and creating entirely new structures to guide the player experience across the growing platform. Designers at Epic drive vision across cross-disciplinary development teams to engage players with goals that enrich their knowledge and tie in to broader forms of progression.

In this role, you will

  • Craft meaningful goals for players that build their exposure, experience, and mastery of new and existing game mechanics, all while immersing them in the world of Fortnite
  • Spearhead innovation in design for the engagement space, including systems, progression, and rewards, fulfilling key engagement metrics and supporting broad systematic framework needs
  • Communicate and represent a vision for the player’s experience to multiple teams across the company, as well as supporting teams of all crafts to optimize their engagement
  • Collaborate with product management and marketing teams to ensure player satisfaction and overall game health while driving growth across the ecosystem and supporting key activations
  • Drive collaborative and iterative live design to prototype quickly, make changes live soon after, learn from them, and iterate

What we’re looking for

  • 10+ years of experience shipping multiple titles as a game designer, working on engagement content or goal-based progression systems in live-service multiplayer environments
  • Demonstrated talent for empathizing with players and a deep understanding of player motivations, forms of play, and the effects of goal setting on play
  • Strong interest in BR and the Fortnite Ecosystem with an understanding of what makes them work
  • Able to react quickly to changing project needs and drive decisions, then own that vision
  • You’re player-focused, passionate, solutions-focused, and innovative. These traits equal success at Epic and influence everything we do

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here.

Note to Recruitment Agencies: Epic does not accept any unsolicited resumes or approaches from any unauthorized third party (including recruitment or placement agencies) (i.e., a third party with whom we do not have a negotiated and validly executed agreement). title: Intensivist - St Jansdal - 0.6 FTE - Jaarcontract met uitzicht op contract voor onbepaalde tijd
description:
intensive care (IC) van het St Jansdal ziekenhuis zijn wij per 1 januari 2026 op zoek naar een enthousiaste en betrokken intensivist. Deze vacature ontstaat door het aanstaande pensioen van één van onze collega’s. Wij zoeken een nieuwe collega die onze multidisciplinaire en collegiale groep komt versterken.

‘Met liefde en compassie de best passende zorg verlenen’ is de missie van het St Jansdal. Er wordt veel waarde gehecht aan laagdrempelige collegiale consultatie en korte lijnen. Samenwerking en loyaliteit kenmerken ons team, waarbij we persoonlijke en betrokken zorg voor onze patiënten centraal stellen.

We hebben een moderne IC met 10 volledig uitgeruste bedden, waarvan momenteel 8 operationeel. De huidige groep bestaat uit 8 intensivisten (5,2 fte), met een diverse achtergrond: vijf anesthesioloog-intensivisten, een chirurg-intensivist, een internist-intensivist en een longarts-intensivist.

Als intensivist verzorg je de dagelijkse werkzaamheden op onze IC. Je bent medisch verantwoordelijk voor de patiëntenzorg, verricht consulten in het ziekenhuis en participeert indien nodig in begeleid spoedtransport. Dagelijks is er een multidisciplinair overleg met wekelijks een pre‑operatieve bespreking die plaatsvindt op de IC. Daarnaast lever je een actieve bijdrage aan de vakgroep overleggen, beleidsontwikkeling en kwaliteitsverbetering. Je werkt zonder voorwacht in een dienstrooster met afwisselend 24‑uurssiensten en dagdiensten en bent samen met je collega’s verantwoordelijk voor een continue en kwalitatief hoogwaardige zorg. Er werken geen ANIOS of PA’s op onze IC, wel wordt er door de vakgroep actief bijgedragen aan de opleiding voor IC‑verpleegkundigen en ziekenhuisartsen.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Een jaarcontract voor 0,6 – 0,7 fte per week met de intentie, bij ongewijzigde organisatorische omstandigheden, deze om te zetten naar een contract voor onbepaalde tijd.
  • Een flexibel rooster met goede werk‑privé balans.
  • AMS is van toepassing

Wat vragen wij van jou?

Je zorgt voor een enthousiaste inbreng en bent een gezellige én professionele collega binnen de vakgroep.

  • Binnen de GIC geregistreerd als intensivist.
  • Een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.
  • Een BIG‑registratie en een inschrijving in het medisch specialistenregister van de RGS

Fellows die de opleiding binnenkort afronden en die voor aanvang van het dienstverband aan de voorwaarden voor GIC‑certificatie voldoen, worden eveneens uitgenodigd te reageren.

Ben je enthousiast?

Solliciteer dan via de sollicitatiebutton op Intensivist (0,6‑0,7fte) | Werken bij St Jansdal . Je kunt jouw sollicitatiebrief richten aan Natascha Diender, zorgmanager. Wil je liever eerst meer informatie over deze functie of wil je een dag meelopen, dan kun je contact opnemen met Kim Selles via het secretariaat van de IC op .

We ontvangen jouw motivatie en CV graag uiterlijk 2 oktober. De sollicitatiegesprekken staan gepland voor dinsdag 7 oktober einde middag – begin van de avond.

Het aanvragen van een VOG (verklaring omtrent gedrag) is onderdeel van de sollicitatieprocedure. Het navragen van recente referenties kan deel uitmaken van de procedure.

Descrição da Empresa

Criada em 2014 a partir da união entre Banco do Brasil e Bradesco, a Livelo é uma das principais empresas de recompensas do Brasil, com mais de 22 milhões de clientes e participantes e dezenas de parceiros de resgate de recompensas e de acúmulo de pontos. Com o objetivo de oferecer a melhor experiência no resgate de pontos, iniciamos nossas operações em 2016 e, em 2017, abrimos nossa plataforma para todos os perfis de clientes.

Para ser cliente da Livelo não precisa ser correntista de determinado banco, voar por determinada companhia aérea, ser portador de determinado cartão, nem mesmo possuir um cartão de crédito. Basta entrar no site e se cadastrar com um CPF válido.

Aqui, o participante conta com mais de 800 mil opções de resgate de produtos e serviços reunidos em um marketplace próprio. No programa, é possível acumular pontos de diferentes formas, seja por meio dos gastos nas lojas parceiras, pela assinatura do Clube Livelo, pelos gastos em diversos cartões de crédito elegíveis, trazendo de outros programas parceiros ou até recebendo pontos da empresa na qual o participante da Livelo trabalha, caso ela seja uma parceira Livelo Incentivo.

Atualmente, temos parcerias estratégicas com grandes empresas e lojas de diversos setores, como varejo online, moda, lazer e entretenimento, alimentos e bebidas, serviços, turismo, ONGs, entre outros. Também contamos com uma agência de viagens online, na qual o participante pode resgatar passagens por mais de 750 companhias aéreas em destinos nacionais e internacionais, reservar hotel ou alugar um carro no Brasil e no mundo utilizando pontos.

Nosso participante ainda tem a liberdade de transferir seus pontos para os principais programas de companhias aéreas nacionais e internacionais, comprar pontos ou assinar o Clube Livelo, com pontos que nunca expiram, potencializando suas recompensas.

Sobre a Área

Tem interesse em fazer parte do nosso time área de Capital Advisory - Infrastructure, e trabalhar em nossa estrutura em São Paulo ?

A área Capital Advisory - Infrastructure , é especializada em fornecer consultoria e suporte para projetos de infraestrutura. As principais atividades e responsabilidades dessa área incluem o serviço de consultoria em projetos de infraestrutura oferecendo assessoria em projetos de grande escala, como construção de rodovias, aeroportos, ferrovias, portos, instalações de energia e telecomunicações, financiamento de projetos, ajudando clientes a identificar e obter financiamento para projetos de infraestrutura, incluindo capital de investidores privados, financiamentos governamentais e outras fontes de financiamento. Estruturação de parcerias público-privadas (PPP), auxiliando na estruturação e implementação de PPPs, ajudando a garantir que os projetos sejam viáveis e atraentes tanto para o setor público quanto para o privado, análise de Viabilidade, realizando estudos de viabilidade econômica, financeira e técnica para assegurar que os projetos de infraestrutura sejam sustentáveis e lucrativos, gestão de riscos e gerenciando os riscos associados a projetos de infraestrutura, incluindo riscos financeiros, operacionais e regulatórios, suporte em fusões e aquisições em transações de M&A no setor de infraestrutura, ajudando clientes a identificar oportunidades, realizar due diligence e negociar termos de acordo, assessorando projetos para garantir conformidade com padrões de sustentabilidade e responsabilidade social, promovendo práticas que minimizem impactos ambientais e sociais negativos. Responsabilidades e Atribuições

Caso seja aprovado(a), você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Elaborar e revisar modelos econômico-financeiros para projetos de infraestrutura.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
About Us

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building.

Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human.

Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page

About the role

Our Engineering team helps Nubank to create and use the technology that provides us to build the best financial products. We strive for state-of-the-art software development practices that currently include a variety of technologies. While we value candidates that are familiar with them, we are also confident that software engineers who are interested in joining Nubank will be able to learn from our team. The software engineer is focused on software development with Clojure as the main programming language (We will teach you Clojure). Main responsibilities:

  • Horizontally scalable microservices written mostly in Clojure, using Finagle and leveraging upon functional programming techniques and hexagonal architecture
  • High throughput jobs and inter-service communication using Kafka
  • Continuous Integration and Deployment into AWS
  • Storing data in Datomic and DynamoDB
  • Monitoring and observability with Prometheus
  • Running as much as possible in Kubernetes

We are a process-light organization that values human interactions. We value working in small, independent teams that feel like small startups within the company, and eschew coupling and centralizing where realistic. We understand that execution is the key to success and optimize processes to remove bottlenecks.

You will be responsible for

  • Work with large scale distributed systems, understanding their broad architecture
  • Set technical direction for multiple teams, ensuring alignment with Business Areas and architecture strategies
  • Drive pragmatic innovation while ensuring resilient and flexible solutions that scale across products and geographies
  • Mentor engineers across teams, establishing and maintaining a high technical bar organization-wide
  • Write, test, instrument, document, and maintain code. Able to pair and participate in code reviews to contribute to the growth of others in and around the team
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Engineering leaders to build new experiences
  • Ensure comprehensive observability, performance monitoring, and error handling across team services
  • Participate in on-call rotations for your team and respond to incidents as necessary
  • Work focused on backend applications, and be open to contribute to mobile and frontend development, according to business needs

We are looking for a person who has

  • At least 10 years of experience developing digital products in complex environments
  • Deep expertise in distributed systems, microservices architecture, and cloud technologies
  • Proven track record of designing and delivering large-scale systems that serve thousands (or even millions) of users
  • Strong background in object-oriented or functional programming languages, with ability to work across multiple languages
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives across multiple teams without direct authority
  • Experience mentoring senior engineers and raising the technical bar across organizations
  • Practical knowledge of agile software development methodologies and previous experience with CI/CD
  • Good communication skills to prevent risks and explain trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Advanced English skills
  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank
  • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)
  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program
  • Life Insurance
  • Medical Plan
  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program
  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses
  • Extended Parental Leave
  • Daycare Allowance
  • Parental Consultancy
  • Work-from-home Allowance
  • 30 days of paid vacation
  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

Our primary language in the Backend is Clojure and it's not a required skill (we won't evaluate your knowledge about it in our process). Still, it's important to be open to learning it. Do you have any interesting cases or experiences using functional paradigm that you'd like to share? :)

Hy brid work model, Porto Alegre Office location.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Here's what you can expect on a typical day:

  • Scrums. You'll start each day with a scrum, working with a team to understand responsibilities, identify issues, and communicate coding priorities;
  • Coding. Working in two-week agile sprints, you must keep up with timelines and coding standards. Although your primary responsibility is to deliver features on time, you may need to dive in to review code, so your coding background will come in handy and contribute to your success;
  • Communications. You're the point of contact for the project. You'll share information with your teammates, mark milestones, and provide metrics and status updates to product owners and project sponsors;

  • Variety of tasks. There is no typical day. You could coach a teammate, deliver a status update to executives in other departments, or make sure we have deployed our resources in the best possible way. You will manage many competing priorities, so a fast pace should not scare you. You pride yourself on having flexibility and agility and can change directions without a second thought;
  • Servant Leadership. Your job is to help everyone else work better. What tasks or issues can you handle so your development team can keep working? What barriers can you remove?;

WHAT WE EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

Experience and Skills:

  • Solid experience in leading & managing multiple complex projects in agile environments (both Scrum and Kanban);

  • Project & Process Management skills, including industry standard project management;

  • Strong knowledge of Flutter, React or Stencil.JS

  • Excellent presentation skills and be able to present project updates in front of small or large groups. Be very competent using tools such as MS PowerPoint;

Education:

  • Degree or equivalent in Computer Sciences or related field: Auniversitydegree is great but not required. What's more important is having the skills and experience to do the job;
  • PMP certified or equivalent - exceptional foundation project management skills. Must be able to demonstrate a full understanding of the product development and release management life cycles;
  • Certified Scrum Master - be able to demonstrate and show previous experience running agile project teams.

YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:

  • Deliver at epic scale. We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity;
  • Be surrounded by curious learners. We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes;
  • Act like an owner & doer. Mission-driven and committed to leading change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems. No tasks are beneath or too great for us. We are hands-on and willing to master our craft;
  • Give back to others. Always do the right thing for our clients and our community and humbly give back to the community where we live and work. Support our associates in times of need through ADP's Philanthropic Foundation;
  • Join a company committed to equality and equity. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.

title: Solutions Architect - Mobility Integrations
description:
Company Overview

If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.

We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don't even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay).

To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more.

Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.

Team Overview

Our technical team is the engine that powers our most innovative partnerships. We are the bridge between 99's platform and the outside world, designing and implementing the integrations that make ambitious ideas a reality. As a Solutions Architect, you will be the lead technical expert for Brazil, architecting API integrations with public and private entities and building automations that streamline our business processes. This role is crucial for our expansion into MaaS and beyond.

Role Responsibilities

  • Leading the technical discovery and design for integrations with external partners, primarily focusing on REST/SOAP APIs.
  • Architecting robust, scalable, and secure integration solutions that connect 99's platform with third-party systems.
  • Developing business process automations using both front-end and back-end technologies to improve internal efficiency and partnership operations.
  • Acting as the primary technical liaison between Brazilian partners and our global Product Management teams in China, requiring excellent English communication skills.
  • Writing clear technical documentation, specifications, and diagrams to guide development and ensure alignment across all teams.
  • Troubleshooting complex technical issues during and after implementation, providing expert guidance to ensure project success.

Role Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in a technical role such as Solutions Architect, API Specialist, Integration Engineer, or Full-Stack Developer.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in designing and consuming APIs (REST, SOAP) and working with common data formats (JSON, XML).
  • Proven experience in process automation with proficiency in back-end (e.g., Python, Node.js) and front-end (e.g., JavaScript) technologies.
  • Excellent professional proficiency in English, with the ability to clearly communicate complex technical concepts to international teams.
  • A problem-solver's mindset, with the ability to analyze complex systems and design elegant, effective solutions. Experience with public transport data standards (GTFS/GTFS-RT) is a major bonus.

EEO Statement

title: Americas Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions
description:
Americas Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu , is widely used in breakthroughs in public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company pioneers global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet 2–4 times yearly in person, in interesting locations worldwide, to align on strategy and execution.

We are hiring a Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions in various locations to drive partnerships for licensing and embedding Ubuntu and Ubuntu Pro into software and SaaS solutions.

Canonical supports ISV customers and alliances in building on Ubuntu and Ubuntu Pro , helping them deliver fast, reliable, secure, compliant, and consistent solutions. We offer the world's most extensive base of open source software, backed by comprehensive SLA support, FIPS‑certified cryptographic compliance, and security commitments that meet HIPAA and FedRAMP standards. We are the top‑rated operating system for developers and partner with every major public cloud provider, ensuring Ubuntu is optimized and integrated with their services, making it easier for ISVs to deploy solutions across multi‑cloud environments. We also collaborate with leading server manufacturers, IoT providers, and silicon vendors to enable, optimize, and certify Ubuntu on their hardware, making it an exceptional choice for ISVs selling physical appliances or traditional software solutions.

The world's biggest brands in AI build on these Ubuntu Pro capabilities to stay focused on product, rather than maintenance or compliance.

Location

Multiple openings in the Americas and in EMEA time zones.

The role entails

  • Drive embedded support and licensing sales with ISVs to exceed quarterly and annual booking targets.
  • Lead customer and partner relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales, customer success and support lifecycle.
  • Deepen understanding and engagement with the open source ecosystem.
  • Identify and develop partnerships that support Canonical's strategic ambitions.
  • Collaborate with product management to ensure fitness and enhancement of our platforms and solutions for ISVs.
  • Negotiate contracts with new and existing ISV partners and customers.
  • Shape content and messaging for ISV partners and customers.

What we are looking for in you

  • Exceptional academic track record from high school and university.
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about an alternative chosen path.
  • Ability to establish strategic relationships with large organisations at all levels.
  • Passion for technology and extensive experience with the software and SaaS industry, Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred), the open source ecosystem, cloud models, and container service offerings.
  • Experience with lead generation and business development in the software sector.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability.
  • Outstanding business English writing and presentation skills.
  • Personal drive to meet commitments and a track record of delivering beyond expectations.
  • Commitment to leadership, skills development and mentorship.
  • Appreciation of diversity and effectiveness in a multicultural, multi‑national organisation.
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long.

What we offer

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person.
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu , one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set very high standards for people joining the company. We expect excellence; to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Coordenador Administrativo Escolar | Curitiba e Pinhais

Seja parte de uma comunidade comprometida para que cada criança e jovem possa construir e alcançar seus sonhos!

Na Tom Educação, acreditamos que a chave para transformar o futuro está em uma educação pública de qualidade. Nossa missão é desenvolver uma comunidade visceralmente comprometida para que todos os estudantes possam construir e alcançar seus sonhos.

A Tom Educação cuida da parte administrativa de escolas públicas por meio de parcerias público-privadas estaduais e municipais. Ao cuidar de toda a parte não-pedagógica da escola, a Tom permite que os diretores das escolas tenham mais tempo para o que mais importa: cuidar dos nossos alunos.

Como Coordenador(a) Administrativo(a) Escolar, você será a liderança responsável pelos temas administrativo-operacionais da escola, garantindo organização, segurança, funcionalidade e eficiência na rotina. Seu trabalho assegura que a equipe pedagógica tenha as condições necessárias para dedicar tempo e atenção aos estudantes, enquanto a escola opera com qualidade e foco em resultados concretos alinhados às necessidades da comunidade escolar e dos objetivos educacionais.

Essa posição é uma peça-chave para o sucesso das operações escolares, garantindo que as questões não-pedagógicas sejam resolvidas com excelência e que o suporte ao Diretor Pedagógico permita o aumento da frequência e do aprendizado dos estudantes.

É o cargo ideal para pessoas que estão buscando oportunidades de liderança reais para transformar a educação brasileira onde ela tem mais potencial: nas escolas públicas.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Implementação do "Setup" da Tom: Durante os 3 primeiros meses, o Coordenador Administrativo será o responsável pela mudança completa que ocorrerá dentro da escola - desde o processo de contratação de professores para zerar aulas vagas até as obras de infraestrutura e reformas que ocorrerão.
  • Liderança Administrativa e Operacional: Gerenciar as atividades administrativas da escola, incluindo as áreas de merenda, inspetoria, limpeza, manutenção, serviços gerais e matrículas. Garantir que os processos operacionais estejam organizados e que as necessidades do dia a dia sejam atendidas de forma eficiente.
  • Apoio ao Diretor Pedagógico: Trabalhar em conjunto com o Diretor Pedagógico para apoiar ações e projetos pedagógicos que visem o aumento da frequência escolar e da aprendizagem dos estudantes. Facilitar a execução de iniciativas que conectem as atividades pedagógicas às necessidades operacionais.
  • Desenvolvimento de Relações Comunitárias: Representar a Tom Educação na comunidade escolar, estabelecendo e fortalecendo relacionamentos com pais, alunos, funcionários e autoridades locais. Trabalhar para elevar a taxa de aceitação do Programa Parceiro da Escola.
  • Conformidade com Regulamentações e Indicadores: Monitorar e garantir que a escola cumpra as normas regulatórias, os contratos estabelecidos e os indicadores de desempenho definidos. Trabalhar para assegurar a transparência na gestão e a aderência às políticas públicas e internas.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação superior completa e, preferencialmente, especialização na área de Gestão Escolar.
  • Habilidades de Liderança: Capacidade de liderar equipes, promover um ambiente colaborativo e motivar os colaboradores para o alcance de metas comuns.
  • Organização e Planejamento: Excelentes habilidades organizacionais, com capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas e prioridades de forma eficiente.
  • Comunicação: Habilidades sólidas de comunicação verbal e escrita, com aptidão para interagir efetivamente com diversos stakeholders, incluindo pais, professores, alunos e autoridades locais.
  • Resolução de Problemas: Capacidade de identificar desafios e desenvolver soluções práticas e eficazes, demonstrando proatividade e iniciativa.
  • Relacionamento Interpessoal: Facilidade para construir e manter relacionamentos positivos, demonstrando empatia e sensibilidade às necessidades da comunidade escolar.
  • Excelência Operacional e Gestão de Processos: Capacidade de garantir coerência, qualidade e eficiência na execução dos processos escolares, com foco em planejamento, monitoramento de resultados e melhoria contínua.

Desta forma, nossas soluções combatem fraudes, protegem dados e promovem a confiança entre pessoas, empresas e governos, colaborando para a construção de um mundo mais seguro e menos burocrático.

Para chegar lá, investimos acima de tudo nas nossas pessoas, que formam um time incrível e comprometido com esse grande objetivo. E aí, vem com a gente?

Nossa cultura

Nossos valores são a base para tudo que fazemos! Aqui na Unico, agimos sem fronteiras; impactamos sem rodeios; somos transparentes mesmo em situações difíceis; resilientes e adaptáveis para evoluir; fazemos a coisa certa do jeito certo e somos ousados ao liderar a construção do futuro. Nosso ambiente de trabalho é descontraído e colaborativo, cheio de oportunidades de aprendizado e possibilidades para você desenvolver sua carreira com autonomia e apoio de líderes e colegas.

Missão : Buscamos uma pessoa Product Designer com alto nível de senioridade para atuar de forma estratégica e “mão na massa” no desenvolvimento de novas iniciativas da Unico. Essa pessoa terá um papel fundamental na construção de produtos com alto grau de inovação, colaborando com áreas estratégicas e contribuindo diretamente para elevar a régua de qualidade do time de Design .


O que você fará/será responsável por:
  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de soluções de design de ponta a ponta em produtos estratégicos da Unico, com foco em experiências simples, eficientes e escaláveis.
  • Atuar de forma transversal entre squads, contribuindo tanto com projetos em estágio de incubação quanto com produtos já consolidados (como IDPay e IDCloud).
